title: Creative Director
description:
**The Company**

Said Differently is an untraditional agency bringing together strategy, creativity, design and technology to build brands, campaigns, products and platforms. We create bespoke teams around each client’s needs, combining a core team with specialists across our global network. Our mission is to build the marketing agency of the future, creating exceptional work through a more flexible, collaborative way of working.

**The role**  
You know how to find the thought that unlocks a brief and bring it to life. Sometimes it starts with a line. Sometimes it’s an image. Sometimes it’s an observation that becomes something neither discipline could have reached alone.

**We’re hiring two hands-on Creative Directors**: one with a deep copywriting background and another who moves comfortably between art and copy. Both will develop brand platforms and integrated campaigns, lead client assignments, and collaborate with freelance specialists across our network while continuing to make work themselves.

**For the copy-focused role,** you can build a brand platform, develop a campaign and write the headline everyone wishes they’d written. You have exceptional writing and editing skills, strong visual judgment, and understand how words and images work together.

**For the art-and-copy role**, you can write a compelling headline, establish a visual direction and bring both together into an idea with a clear point of view. Your particular strengths may lean toward one discipline, but your portfolio should show meaningful contributions to both.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Turn business challenges and strategic insights into distinctive creative platforms and integrated campaigns.
* Lead the creative work on assignments from the first conversation through production and delivery, protecting the idea as it evolves.
* Write headlines, scripts, concept narratives and other copy across film, social, digital, out of home, brand voice and other relevant channels.
* For the art-and-copy role, create visual directions, layouts and storyboards that communicate the idea.
* Partner with freelance writers, art directors, designers and other specialists, providing clear direction and useful feedback.
* Recognize when an idea needs stronger writing, better art direction or a different approach entirely.
* Build persuasive presentations and lead creative conversations with clients, explaining the thinking and building confidence in ambitious ideas.
* Help select and brief the right specialists for each assignment.
* Partner with strategy, account leadership and production to deliver strong work within the scope, budget and timeline.
* Contribute to pitches and identify creative opportunities within existing client relationships.

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

* 10+ years in advertising or brand creativity, with experience leading creative work at ACD or Creative Director level.
* A portfolio of original, strategically grounded ideas brought to life across multiple channels.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with range across brands, audiences and tones. The copy-focused role requires exceptional depth in this craft.
* Strong visual judgment and the ability to direct the complete campaign. The art-and-copy role also requires hands-on visual craft and proficiency with relevant design and presentation tools.
* Production experience relevant to your practice, including film, photography or digital content.
* Confidence working directly with clients and navigating feedback without losing the central idea.
* A generous approach to collaboration and the confidence to make clear creative decisions.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging creative tools, with sound judgment about where they improve the work.
* The independence and communication skills to lead within a distributed team.

  

**Show us**  
A portfolio that demonstrates your craft and creative leadership. Tell us what you made, what you led and how you helped make the work happen.

**Working Hours**

We are a remote company and welcome candidates based in the US and internationally. Our team generally works Eastern Time hours, and this role requires availability during the standard Eastern Time workday to collaborate with colleagues and meet client needs.

title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded haircare brand dedicated to restoring crowns and confidence. What began as a kitchen remedy has evolved into one of the most celebrated textured-hair care brands in the U.S., loved for our authentic story, transformative results, and community-first approach.

It’s an exciting time to join our team as we grow and build a culture rooted in creativity, collaboration, and care. Together, we’re shaping the next chapter of a brand powered by community and led by purpose to help people everywhere love their hair, love their journey, and love themselves.

**Role Overview**

Bask & Lather is seeking an Art Director, Brand & Design to bring our brand to life across campaigns, digital experiences, product packaging, retail displays, and experiential marketing.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a strong designer who can develop compelling concepts, personally execute key creative, and lead graphic designers to deliver cohesive, commercially effective work. You will translate brand strategy into clear visual direction and help build the systems, standards, and team capabilities needed to support a growing beauty brand.

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Art Direction & Brand Design**

* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for integrated campaigns, product launches, and ongoing brand marketing.
* Translate approved brand strategy into clear art direction, design briefs, and cohesive execution across customer touchpoints.
* Maintain and evolve design standards, templates, and asset libraries within the brand’s established identity.
* Art direct photography, short-form video, creator content, and product demonstrations, including mood boards, composition, styling, and post-production guidance. Ensure clear product education and consistent brand presentation.

**Hands-On Creative Execution**

* Personally design key creative across e-commerce, social, email, paid media, marketplaces, sales materials, and brand campaigns.
* Develop platform-specific creative for TikTok Shop, paid and organic social, creator content, and livestream shopping, adapting storytelling and design to how customers discover and purchase on each channel.
* Translate customer questions, hair concerns, cultural insights, and relevant trends into creative that resonates with our audience and reflects the brand’s voice and standards.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-Commerce, and the Director of Creative Performance to develop and refine creative using performance insights and customer feedback, supporting structured testing and iteration.

**Packaging, Retail & Experiential Design**

* Design packaging, labels, cartons, kits, and other physical brand materials from concept through production-ready artwork.
* Develop retail displays, merchandising assets, signage, and environmental graphics that translate the brand into physical spaces.
* Work with internal partners and external vendors on dielines, specifications, proofs, color, materials, and finishes.
* Ensure artwork includes approved content and completes the required cross-functional reviews before production.

**Team Leadership & Creative Operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop graphic designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback.
* Prioritize projects, balance workloads, and maintain accountability for creative quality and deadlines.
* Review deliverables for brand consistency, accuracy, channel suitability, and production readiness.
* Build scalable workflows that improve turnaround time and reduce unnecessary revisions while maintaining high standards.

**Key KPIs & Success Metrics**

* A cohesive, recognizable brand across digital and physical touchpoints.
* Strong creative delivered accurately and on time.
* A design team with clear direction, useful feedback, and consistent standards.
* Packaging and displays that meet brand, retailer, and production requirements.
* Creative systems that support growth and improve team efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional brand design or creative experience, including experience leading designers and providing art direction.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating consumer brand campaigns, photography and short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand experiences.
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with strong typography, composition, layout, and image-editing skills.
* Practical knowledge of packaging and print production, including dielines, artwork preparation, color management, and proof review.
* Experience designing for e-commerce and digital marketing, with an understanding of how creative supports customer education and conversion.
* Strong judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to move projects forward independently.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to balance personal execution with effective delegation.
* Experience in beauty, haircare, skincare, wellness, or consumer packaged goods is strongly preferred. Experience supporting social commerce, particularly TikTok Shop, is strongly preferred. Ability to direct video and motion work is required; hands-on motion design or video editing is a plus.

**Why Join Bask & Lather Co.?**

* Be part of a passionate, fast-paced team changing the narrative around scalp care
* Play a pivotal role in a high-growth, high-impact brand with national reach
* Directly support strategic initiatives and help shape scalable infrastructure
* Competitive salary, collaborative culture, and room to grow with the business

**Benefits**

title: Art Director, Motion and Brand
description:
### **About PrePass**

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

### **About the Role**

The PrePass marketing team is tasked with expanding the PrePass brand. We are energized by the prospect of breaking ground in our field and making a positive impact within the transportation industry. We are looking for an Art Director, Motion and Brand, with strong design, motion, and animation fundamentals and a passion for visual storytelling. This person not only values great craftsmanship but also knows how to turn complex products and ideas into clear, compelling video and animation that share the PrePass story and purpose with our customers.

As the Art Director, Motion and Brand, you'll work with the Senior Art Director, the Director of Marketing Comms, and the larger Marketing team to bring the PrePass brand to life in motion. You'll own video and animated content for performance marketing campaigns, product launches, social, web, and events, with secondary responsibility for digital design across email, social, landing pages, and other channels. This role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables.

### **Essential Responsibilities**

### **Video, Motion, and Animation**

* Conceptualize, storyboard, and produce video and animated content for social, web, email, paid media, webinars, and trade show screens.
* Create product explainers, animated demos, and short-form videos that make complex solutions—toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety—easy to understand.
* Design and animate 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, illustrated animation, and animated data visualizations.
* Edit and finish video from raw footage, including pacing, sound design, music selection, captioning, and color correction.
* Support video shoots, customer testimonials, and event coverage, from shot lists to final edit.
* Build animated brand elements, including logo animations, lower thirds, transitions, and title sequences.
* Develop motion guidelines and reusable templates that keep video and animated content consistent and on-brand.

### **Brand and Creative Support**

* Design marketing assets, including emails, social graphics, landing pages, web banners, and paid ads.
* Create supporting collateral and assets for campaigns and events, such as video thumbnails, ad variations, and presentation graphics.
* Extend the PrePass visual brand identity consistently across video, motion, and digital channels.
* Generate strong conceptual ideas aligned with strategic business goals.
* Clearly articulate creative rationale, concepts, and visual direction to key stakeholders.
* Contribute to all phases of the creative process: research, brainstorming, scripts, storyboards, animatics, style frames, and final production.

### **Collaboration and Tools**

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.
* Use design and production tools such as Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and Asana, along with generative AI tools such as Adobe Firefly and Google Flow, to speed up ideation and production.
* Prepare and optimize files for each channel, including aspect ratios, file sizes, and accessibility standards.

### **Project Execution**

* Manage day-to-day workflow while meeting deadlines across multiple initiatives.
* Support marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, and product launches with motion and design assets.
* Stay current on design, animation, and video trends and bring fresh ideas to the team.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications/Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in design, motion graphics, and animation, gained at an agency, startup, or in-house team.
* A portfolio and reel that showcase polished video editing, motion graphics, animation, and strong design fundamentals—including typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.

* A self-starter who takes full ownership of design projects, both large and small.
* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage timelines across multiple initiatives.

* B2B marketing experience, especially translating technical products into clear visual stories.
* Experience with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender), AI-assisted design and video tools, or Lottie/web animation.
* Knowledge of the transportation, logistics, or fleet management industry.

**Join Us**

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

**Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Foundation**

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

**Mission of the Role**

You own the quality bar for everything creative Foundation delivers: written content, design, video, and social and ad creative. You make sure the work clients get is clear, distinctive and built to be found and cited, and that every pod holds it to the same standard. Your job is making the work better and keeping it that way as we grow.

You work across all of our client teams. Each team is led by a Group AEO Marketing Director who owns a book of clients, with an AEO Program Director who runs delivery. Our writers, designers, editors and producers sit in those pods. The Head of Paid Media, the Head of Organic & AI Visibility and their leads set the standard for their channels. You hold the creative bar across all of them.

**Reports to:** Head of Client Services. Direct reports: creative makers not yet placed in pods. Dotted line: the writers, designers, editors and producers in every pod and through our freelance partners.

**What you'll own:**

* The quality gate. You design the creative quality check every piece goes through before it reaches a client: the criteria, the checklists, and who runs it in each pod. Pods run the check day to day. You review a sample of work each week, handle escalations, and personally review high-stakes work, such as a new client’s first deliverables. Work that isn’t ready goes back with feedback the maker can act on.
* The creative standard. You set and document what great looks like at Foundation: guidelines, examples, storytelling and brand frameworks, and the checklists the gate uses.
* Your team. You manage and develop the creative makers who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. When each pod can keep one busy, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.
* Creative hiring. You run the technical skill assessment part of every creative hire and have a veto on creative quality.
* Creative levelling. You define what each level of writer, designer, editor and producer looks like, and give input on their promotions.
* Coaching. You give the people who make the work regular, specific feedback, train them, and close skills gaps across pods.
* AI in the creative workflow. You build and roll out AI tools and workflows that raise quality and speed, and make sure AI-assisted work still meets the bar.
* Partners and freelancers. You make sure third-party creators and editors meet the same standard as our own team.

**What you bring:**

  

* 8+ years in creative leadership for B2B brands, in an agency or in-house, with a portfolio across writing, design and video.
* You've built a quality system before: standards, review gates and feedback loops that held up as volume grew.
* You make the call. You hold the bar under deadline pressure and say no when work isn't ready, without needing someone more senior to back you.
* You've already built things with AI: agents, tools or workflows you use in real creative work, and you can show us how you built them. Hands-on time with tools like Claude, Figma, Higgsfield, HeyGen or ElevenLabs counts. If you haven't built with AI yet, this role isn't the right fit right now.
* Experience teaching others: you've made writers, designers and editors better, including people who don't report to you.

title: Head of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

*Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

**The role**
------------

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

**The day-to-day**
------------------

* Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
* Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
* Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
* Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
* Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.
* Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.
* Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.

**You should apply if you**
---------------------------

* Hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master's preferred).
* Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.
* Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).
* Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.
* Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
* Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
* Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
* Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
* Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.

**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn't work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive salary** and **VSOP options**
* **Relocation support**: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
* **Learning**: €500/£450 yearly allowance
* **Health & wellness**: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
* **Social**: regular company events and monthly social allowances
* **Enhanced parental leave**: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Family support:** 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled "Infraduction"), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

*These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.*

  

*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Hilo by Aktiia**

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

### **Role overview**

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

### **Core responsibilities**

### **Direction & Outcomes**

* Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
* Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

### **Design System & Prototyping**

* Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
* Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
* Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
* Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

 **Requirements**

### **Background & Experience**

### **Essential**

* Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
* 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
* Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
* High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
* Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
* Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
* Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
* A public portfolio website (required with your application).

### **Nice to Have**

* Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

### **How you work**

* AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
* Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
* Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
* Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
* Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
* Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

### **This isn't for you if**

* You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
* You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
* You'd rather list risks than own one.

### **How we hire**

* Recruiter screen (30 min)
* Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
* Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
* Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
* Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

### **What success looks like**

* You take something off our plate and it gets done.
* If it won't happen, you tell us first.
* You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
* You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
* The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

  
**Benefits**

### **What Makes You A Great Fit**

**At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:**

**Move the Needle** — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

**Move Fast, Learn, Refine** — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

**Team First** — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
* Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
* Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
* Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
* Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

### **Ready to Move the Needle?**

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

===================

You will:

* Execute projects pertaining to new product introduction, new technology integration, and field issue resolution with a heavy focus on quality and reliability verified by physical testing
* Be responsible for designing yaw system components for wind turbines focusing on hydraulic pressure unit (HPU) systems, yaw bearings, yaw drives, and yaw brakes encompassing component design, system interaction, and system reliability
* Hold ownership of and drive lessons learned, best practices, and standardization into design related documentation such as design practices, drawings, and technical specifications
* Responsible for design, development of testing/validation plans to prove component function and reliability
* Provide innovative design solutions to meet aggressive timing, product cost, and reliability targets

* Work cross functionally, developing strong relationships with quality teams, manufacturing engineers, sourcing, suppliers, field support, and others to improve product quality and first-time yield
* Support manufacturing, sourcing, and the field with issue resolution and quick corrective actions for design related causes (NCR, SDR, PAC)
* Drive quick, complete technical root cause analysis of field failures and identify design related corrective actions to prevent recurrence
* Identify and execute cost saving ideas and strategies
* Drive efforts to introduce advanced technology, materials, manufacturing methods, new design tools/methods to advance the strategic position of yaw subsystem components
  

  

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Proven experience in mechanical analysis and design experience in industry
* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing
* Experience with 3D-CAD tools like Unigraphics / Siemens NX
* Excellent communication, project management, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across cultural boundaries
* Ability to work under pressure and challenging conditions
* Established problem solving process knowledge and execution
* Strong desire and ability to drive improvement and change
* Fluent English written and spoken
* Ability to travel up to 10%

* Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Working knowledge of Ansys or other finite element analysis tools
* Design experience working on components in the wind turbine yaw subsystem (yaw drives, yaw bearings, bolted joints, hydraulic + mechanical yaw braking systems)
* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA, and design for manufacturability / installation / serviceability.
* Proven track record of collaborating with business product managers and suppliers/vendors to optimize component costs and influence purchasing strategy

**Associate Partner, Management Consulting – Energy & Utilities, Iberia**

Working side by side with clients, we deliver integrated solutions that span the full lifecycle of change, from initial strategy to sustained impact. We are focussed on fostering an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives.

  

In Iberia (Spain and Portugal), we are building the practice from the ground up, with Data & AI at its core and an initial focus on Banking & Insurance, Energy & Utilities and the Public Sector. We connect strategy, technology and execution end-to-end, from the first diagnosis through to production.

  

**Your role will involve:**

As Associate Partner for Energy & Utilities, you’ll work closely with the Consulting Partner to build and grow the sector across Iberia, with Data & AI as the engine of transformation. Your challenge is to help energy companies and utilities turn AI into measurable results: running their networks and assets more efficiently, accelerating the energy transition, meeting growing regulatory demands and building the data foundations that make AI work at scale.

  

As a market-facing visionary, you’ll be targeted to pursue new revenue and business development opportunities, whilst nurturing key client relationships, and leading collaborative, high-performing consulting teams. Your exceptional ability to build and maintain lasting, trusted relationships will empower clients to fulfil their business aspirations.

  

As a thought leader in your field, you’ll influence the future of Uvance Wayfinders consulting, bringing fresh perspectives and creative, innovative solutions.

  

**As an Associate Partner, you will be responsible for:**

**Business Development**

* Driving the go-to-market strategy for Energy & Utilities in Iberia and leading business development efforts, including proactive proposals, RFPs and executive presentations, resulting in standalone consulting revenue growth.
* Defining our Data & AI proposition for energy companies and utilities, from AI strategy and Agentic AI to data foundations, across networks, operations, the energy transition and customers.
* Originating and scaling strategic transformation opportunities, from use-case portfolios and business cases to enterprise-wide programmes.
* Identifying pull-through opportunities for technology solutions and services through consulting engagements and gained knowledge of clients’ business challenges.
* Shaping complex value cases and facilitating executive workshops that link AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.
* Leading deal shaping, pricing and commercial negotiations, and managing revenue, margin and delivery health across engagements.
* Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities with energy companies and utilities across Iberia.
* Creating eminence and thought leadership through provocative points of view on AI, the energy transition and critical infrastructure.
  

**Client delivery & leadership**

* Setting the direction for complex, multi-disciplinary consulting engagements, identifying the right functional knowledge, technical expertise and proprietary tools required to deliver.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to the C-suite of energy companies and utilities, turning emerging technologies into pragmatic roadmaps and measurable value.
* Leading Agentic AI and Generative AI programmes from opportunity and business case through architecture, implementation and adoption.
* Applying AI to networks and operations: predictive maintenance, asset and network management, digital twins and field operations.
* Building scalable data foundations: data strategy, data governance, operating models and modern architectures, including data for sustainability reporting.
* Advising clients on how to deploy AI in line with sector regulation, including the EU AI Act requirements for critical infrastructure, NIS2 and sustainability reporting.
* Collaborating with the wider Uvance Wayfinders network and technology partners to bring the right capabilities and solutions to each client challenge.
* Providing senior technical oversight across multiple AI and data engagements.
* Validating architectural approaches spanning data platforms, machine learning, large language models, AI agents and orchestration layers.
* Ensuring AI solutions are production-grade, scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards, with strong engineering discipline and MLOps practices.
* Guiding teams on trade-offs between rules-based systems, machine learning, LLMs and hybrid approaches.
* Acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical, architectural or Responsible AI decisions.
* Building and sustaining long-term client relationships, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
  

**Practice development**

* Collaborating with the Consulting Partner to shape the Energy & Utilities offering, including methodologies, accelerators and thought leadership.
* Building a high-performing Energy & Utilities team, providing direction, mentorship and quality assurance over team performance and deliverables.
* Working with Uvance Wayfinders partners across Europe and with the teams already present in client accounts.
* Inspiring Uvance Wayfinders consultants to realise their full potential, supporting collaboration, continuous development and a culture where talent thrives.
  

**Your transferable skills and experience:**

* 14+ years of experience in consulting or equivalent senior industry leadership roles, including experience at Associate Partner, Principal Director, Director or Managing Director level in a tier-one consultancy or technology advisory firm.
* Proven ability to build trusted C-suite relationships and originate consulting revenue.
* Experience working with energy and utilities clients in Iberia (electricity networks, generation, energy retail or oil & gas).
* Hands-on leadership of Data & AI in the energy sector: Agentic AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics, data strategy and data governance.
* Track record leading large multidisciplinary teams and project portfolios, balancing growth, delivery quality and talent.
* Solid knowledge of the sector’s regulatory framework, including the EU AI Act, NIS2, sustainability reporting (such as CSRD) and the role of the energy regulators (CNMC and ERSE), and its impact on AI initiatives.
* Experience building practices or offerings from scratch and taking them to market.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach to growing, developing and inspiring cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of modern data and AI architectures, including cloud-native data platforms and pipelines, machine learning and advanced analytics, LLM-based solutions (prompting, RAG, agents), and orchestration, monitoring and lifecycle management.
* Experience overseeing AI systems in production and understanding their operational risks: performance, drift, reliability and security.
* Proven ability to build complex value cases and to facilitate workshops with senior decision-makers to shape engagement outcomes.
* Strong commercial acumen, with revenue and margin accountability.
* University degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* Fluent Spanish and professional English; Portuguese is a plus.
  

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with IoT, OT/SCADA environments or digital twins.
* Experience in energy transition programmes (renewables, electrification, storage or hydrogen).
* Experience with ecosystems, technology partnerships or acquisitions.
* Market presence through executive teaching, speaking or publications.
  

**Recruitment process:** The recruitment process consists of 3 stages.

  

**About Uvance Wayfinders**

Uvance Wayfinders is Fujitsu’s global consulting business, launched in February 2024. The name reflects what we do: help organisations find their way when the route is unknown or uncertain, from setting direction and designing the strategic path to guiding implementation. We combine AI-driven consulting, deep industry expertise and advanced technology to turn strategy into measurable business outcomes, connecting strategy, architecture, technology and execution from planning through to adoption. Our services span four domains: Industries, Operations, Experiences and Technologies.

We are people centric: Our hybrid work environments enable you to Be Completely You. Our active people-led Inclusive Community networks are representative of all aspects of diversity and are instrumental in enabling and supporting our innovative approach to inclusion.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Design the solution and data**

* You help shape the data model and integrations, then build, test and support reliable production code with the wider team.
* Most of our depth sits in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, but the architecture rarely stops at one platform.
* Relational schemas, keys, retention, extract and ingestion strategies.
* Identity resolution across fragmented sources.

**2. Build the integrations**

* REST, SOAP, webhooks, batch or event-driven - you help select the right pattern, implement it and ensure failures recover safely.
* Work at the warehouse and CDP layer, not just the activation platform at the end of it.

**3. Build maintainable solutions**

* Build with AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid, Jinja or general-purpose code, depending on the platform and problem.
* Queries and automation logic driving segmentation and journeys at volume.
* Improve the team's versioning, review and deployment practices where they add value.
* Decisions documented so they outlast your engagement.

**4. Translate for the client**

* Shape ambiguous requirements into something buildable and present the solution yourself.

**What You Bring**

**1. Software Engineering**

* Production experience with Node.js, Python, Java, PHP or .NET.
* You write maintainable, tested and idempotent code with effective error handling and logging.

**2. Data Engineering and Architecture**

* Strong SQL against large datasets - not just reads, but the queries that drive segmentation and automation.
* You understand customer identity resolution across fragmented sources, including deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship and profile consolidation.

**3. Integration and Delivery**

* Delivered a production integration using REST, SOAP or webhooks.
* Understands batch and event-driven patterns, rate limits, retries, failure recovery and duplicate prevention.
* Hands-on version control in a team setting - branching, pull requests, peer review.

**4. Front-end Development**

* Comfortable building and debugging rendered output with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

**5. Marketing Platform Delivery**

* Hands-on delivery on an enterprise marketing or CRM platform - Salesforce, Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe or equivalent.
* Built audience segmentation and multi-step customer journeys against a live data source.
* Worked directly with marketing stakeholders on requirements, not only via a ticket queue.

**Bonus experience**

* Additional Marketing Automation Experience: Salesforce Personalization, Pardot or Marketing Cloud Next; Adobe Campaign, Journey Optimizer or Marketo Engage; or HubSpot.
* Core CRM Platforms: Salesforce Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce or Industry Clouds.
* CDP Platforms: Data Cloud, Tealium, Segment or equivalent.
* Platform Development: AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid, Jinja.
* Data Engineering and Architecture: ETL / ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data governance, big data.
* APIs & Integration: GraphQL.
* Front-end Development: React, Angular, Vue.
* DevOps: CI/CD, SFMC DevTools, Salesforce CLI, Copado, Gearset.
* Email Development: Responsive email build, including cross-client and dark mode testing.
* Email Deliverability: Sending reputation and authentication - SPF, DKIM, DMARC, dedicated IP warming.

**How You Work**

**1.Stay hands-on across the delivery lifecycle**

* This is a hands-on developer role. You help design and build solutions using platform languages, SQL and the appropriate integration technologies.
* You also review, audit, migrate and improve inherited solutions.
* You build solutions that are bulk-safe, observable and tested, with error handling and logging included from the start.
* You name things properly, you leave comments where the platform forced an ugly decision, and you don't hand over a black box.

**2. Platform-pragmatic**

* You work the constraint rather than resenting it. Enterprise marketing platforms often won't let you build the elegant solution, and you find the one that holds.
* You know when a platform's native tooling is enough and when the problem belongs in real code.

**3. Design, document and deliver responsibly**

* You consider the data model and integration pattern before building, keeping the design effort proportionate to the problem.
* You write the design down. Decisions and trade-offs outlast your engagement.
* You take responsibility for what you ship and can diagnose production issues.
* Your work lives in version control, gets reviewed by peers, and deploys the same way twice.
* You'd rather have a design challenged early than find the problem in production.

**4. Client-facing across disciplines**

* You lead requirements discussions and present solutions clearly to both marketing and technical stakeholders.
* You adapt the level of detail to your audience.
* You work closely with campaign operations, data engineers, developers and strategists, translating effectively between disciplines.

**In return, this is what we offer**

We encourage ambitious ideas, invest in your development and support a flexible, welcoming workplace.

**Our compensation**

* An annual gross salary of €43,700–€50,000, depending on experience.
* Company private health insurance.

**Career progression**

* We'll help you build either path through demonstrated impact, growing responsibility and business need.

**Our culture**

title: Project Accountant
description:
