title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for the top 1% - engineers who treat their craft like athletes treat performance, and who want to work alongside people who do the same. The world has changed dramatically in the last quarter. What used to take a team of consultants six months now takes a sharp engineer a few days. The momentum is unreal, and we're growing into it fast.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're embedded directly in our customers' environments, taking a messy enterprise problem from first conversation to a working production system in days - not quarters. You work as part of a small senior team - alongside a Senior Consultant and other FDEs - and you own the technical solution end-to-end: architecture, integrations, agent and workflow logic, frontend where needed, evals, deployment. The work starts and ends with the customer, not the codebase. Feedback cycles are measured in hours, the bar is high, and the people you ship with will push you to raise it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Sit with end-users, process owners, and client engineers to understand the real workflow - and the real problem underneath the stated one
* Translate the target-state process into a concrete technical solution: architecture, data model, integrations, agent and workflow design - and ship it in days and weeks, not quarters
* Demo early and often, rough edges included, and fold real feedback into the next iteration
* Make speed / quality / cost trade-offs in real time. Choose build vs. buy vs. configure existing platform capability
* Own observability and evals once live. Iterate until the system is reliable in the customer's real conditions
* Earn trust with the client's own engineering and security teams - API access, data flows, deployment, reviews
* Bring patterns back - reusable components, prompt structures, integration approaches - so the next engagement ships faster

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Builder background with real shipping experience - you've taken systems from zero to production and kept them running
* Fluent with modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, agent frameworks, evals, prompt engineering as a real discipline
* Strong with TypeScript on the backend. Comfortable with APIs, auth, queues, and integrating with legacy systems
* Daily, fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor, or similar - expected to ship meaningfully faster than a traditional engineer because of them
* Customer-facing instinct - you genuinely enjoy being in the room with users, asking sharp questions, and pushing back respectfully when needed
* You move fast, communicate clearly, and operate well with ambiguity. Comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar domain and coming back with a working prototype
* Fluency in English. German is a plus
* **MUST**: experience automating business processes in the ERP space (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar), or prior background in consulting, solutions engineering, or founding/building products end-to-end

**What you'll get**
-------------------

* **Ship in days, not quarters.** Watch a messy enterprise problem become a working production system inside a single engagement.
* **Work at the frontier.** We use and build with state-of-the-art tech, the latest LLMs, agent frameworks, and AI coding tools, with the budget and mandate to keep up as the field moves.
* **Build with the best tools.** No legacy stack to drag around.
* **Big responsibility, fast.** You own customer engagements end-to-end from day one: architecture, build, delivery, and the relationship.
* **A team that raises the bar.** You're working alongside other FDEs and senior consultants who were hired for exactly this pace.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About Graitec Group:

Graitec is a global leader in Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions, designing and developing software that helps architects, engineers, and manufacturers design smarter and better. With over 30 years of innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, we’ve tripled our revenue in just five years.

Our North Star is clear — accelerate the digital transformation of the AECO industry and model the future. We  
achieve this by growing our recurring revenue through innovative software and services that drive adoption,  
integration, and lasting value for our customers.

Our 800 experts across 30+ offices in 12 countries support more than 270,000 users worldwide. As a global Autodesk Platinum Partner, we combine world-class partnerships with our own cutting-edge software and services to drive performance and sustainability across the industry.

At Graitec, we move fast and think big. We collaborate across teams and borders, embrace diversity, and challenge ourselves to innovate every day. We believe in doing the right thing, breaking down silos, and making an impact together.

**How we work:** Growth, Agility, Innovation, Responsibility  
**How we behave:** Ambition, Engagement, One Graitec, Positive Energy

Learn more about the Graitec Group: graitec-group.com/graitec-a-global-player

About the Team Hiring:

IT & Business Transformation is a global function reporting to the Graitec CEO, made up of four teams: Business Transformation, Data & AI, Information Security, and IT Operations & Platforms. Together we own the delivery capability behind how Graitec operates and we drive Graitec’s continued transformation.

We work as fusion teams and as one with the wider organisation: technology and business colleagues working towards the same goals and outcomes.

Data & AI is the team that turns Graitec's data into decisions. It brings together data platform engineering, BI and machine learning development, data science, AI engineering, and business-aligned analysts embedded with the functions they serve. The team is growing, and you will help shape how it works.

Overview:

Business Purpose & Value Contribution

The Data Platform Engineer builds and runs the platform that all of Graitec's reporting, analytics and AI depend on: the Microsoft Fabric data lake, the pipelines that feed it, and the controls that keep it reliable, secure and affordable.

The priority is a governed single source of truth: data from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, services

licensing and product telemetry, integrated once, modelled consistently and served to every function, with sensitive data protected by design.

You will work with the Data and AI Leader, BI developers, IT Operations & Platforms, Information Security and R&D. It is a hands-on senior engineering role, setting the patterns others build on.

Key Outcomes Expected

What success looks like in the first 12 months

* A published data platform architecture and engineering standards, with a layered data model in use
* Core sources ingested reliably and monitored, with failures detected before users notice
* Platform capacity right-sized and its cost transparent, with workloads separated so reporting and engineering do not collide
* Access, classification and privacy controls in place, including for HR and financial data
* Pipelines and models in source control, with automated deployment across environments
* A clear interface with R&D for product telemetry and shared data platforms

Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

* Design, build and run the Microsoft Fabric platform: lakehouses, warehouses, pipelines and dataflows
* Ingest and integrate data from Dynamics 365, CRM, Kantata, licensing and telemetry, using standard connectors and APIs where they fit
* Build a layered, medallion-style data model that turns raw data into certified, reusable datasets
* Resolve customer and product identities across CRM, ERP, licensing and telemetry, so every report counts the same customer once

Reliability & Cost

* Monitor pipelines and automate data quality tests for completeness, freshness, uniqueness and referential integrity, with alerting and clear ownership of failures
* Manage platform capacity and cost, separating workloads and scaling only when justified
* Run source control, environments and deployment pipelines for data and BI content

Security & Governance

* Implement access, classification, row- and column-level security, masking and privacy controls with Information Security
* Protect sensitive data such as compensation, using anonymisation and restricted workspaces
* Maintain lineage and documentation, supporting the data governance the business agrees

Collaboration

* Set engineering standards and coach BI developers and analysts in using them
* Work with the Enterprise Architect and R&D on integration patterns, master data and telemetry
* Prepare data for AI, exposing governed, well-described data to agents and models through controlled interfaces

Responsibilities:

* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, including at least two years working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Databricks.
* Strong experience with SQL and Python or PySpark, and data modelling for analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, and OneLake.
* Experience integrating ERP and CRM data, ideally from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Dataverse.
* Experience with master data management and entity resolution, including matching customers and products across multiple systems.
* Practical experience implementing security and governance, including Entra ID, row-level security, and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience managing capacity and costs on a shared analytics platform.
* Uses AI tools such as Copilot in day-to-day work for code generation, testing, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to document effectively and explain technical trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders.
* Experience with product telemetry or event-driven data.
* Experience preparing data for AI solutions, including retrieval, vector search, and governed access for agents (for example through MCP).
* Experience with other modern data platforms and tools such as dbt, Snowflake, or Databricks, and with infrastructure as code.

Qualifications:

* Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Python/PySpark** development.
* Expertise in **analytics-focused data modelling** and data architecture.
* Deep knowledge of **Microsoft Fabric** technologies, including:
  + Lakehouse
  + Warehouse
  + Data Pipelines
  + Notebooks
  + OneLake
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD practices for data platforms**, including Git and Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of enterprise **security, governance, and compliance frameworks**, including:
  + Entra ID
  + Row-Level Security (RLS)
  + Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of data platform operations, including performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Practical application of AI-assisted development tools such as **Copilot**.
* **Preferred Certifications**
  + Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (**DP-700**)
  + Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (**DP-600**)
* Familiarity with modern AI data architectures, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Vector Search
  + MCP-enabled data access and governance
* Knowledge of modern data engineering ecosystems, including:
  + dbt
  + Snowflake
  + Databricks
  + Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

Interview Process:

**At Graitec, we’re proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace.**

We value our employees for who they are and the contributions they bring, encouraging everyone to be their

authentic selves at work. This diversity helps us better serve the wide range of customers and markets we

operate in. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and assess candidates solely on their skills and

ability to succeed in the role.

Graitec uses AI to support and streamline internal processes; however, all application reviews, screening, and

hiring decisions are made solely by our Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers.

* **HR Screening –** An initial “get to know you” discussion.
* **Technical Assessment Interview –** May include a presentation or a collaborative exercise.
* **Hiring Manager Interview –** A role-specific discussion with the hiring manager.
* **Final Interview –** Conversation with the Business Unit Leader.

Additional Information

As a signatory of **United Nations Women’s Empowerment Principles**, Graitec is committed to equal opportunity and

pay transparency.

**On Target Earning pay range for this role**

* **Role Targeted Variable Pay Mix:** 10%
* **Minimum Annual On Target Earning:** € 40,000
* **Maximum Annual On Target Earning:** € 60,000

**Note:** Salary range indicated in this add is for information only & targeted for a specific seniority level and targeted location. Final salary offer might vary depending on final candidate location, seniority, competencies...

title: Tech Lead
description:
En 011h estamos revolucionando el sector de la construcción para hacerlo más sostenible, eficiente y digital. Diseñamos y construimos edificios con una visión industrializada, utilizando tecnologías innovadoras y materiales responsables con el planeta, como la madera. Nuestra misión es clara: construir mejor, para todos.

Somos la primera plataforma digital "end to end" para la construcción en Europa. Combinamos el conocimiento de la arquitectura y la ingeniería con el poder de la tecnología para estandarizar procesos, automatizar tareas y escalar soluciones que transformen el sector sin renunciar al diseño, la calidad ni el impacto positivo.

En 011h, profesionales del diseño, la construcción y el software trabajan de forma colaborativa en un entorno dinámico, ambicioso y orientado a la sostenibilidad. Si te inspira la idea de cambiar cómo se construye el mundo, este es tu lugar.

Actualmente, nuestro ámbito de actividad es España, con perspectivas de internacionalización en los próximos años.

En 011h buscamos a un/a Tech Lead que se una a nuesto equipo:

**Qué harás:**

* Liderar un squad de 3-6 ingenieros full-stack como su manager, marcando el rumbo técnico del dominio y siendo responsable de la calidad de lo que entregamos.
* Gestionar a las personas de tu equipo: 1:1s, feedback, evaluación del desempeño, desarrollo profesional y participación en la contratación.
* Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de microservicios con enfoque Domain-Driven Design, escribir ADRs y guiar decisiones de trade-off (build vs. buy, deuda técnica vs. delivery, consistencia vs. autonomía).
* Mantenerte hands-on: aproximadamente la mitad de tu tiempo seguirá siendo desarrollo, especialmente en las partes más críticas o de mayor riesgo del sistema.
* Liderar el code review y la mentoría del squad, elevando el nivel técnico del equipo y desbloqueando a tus compañeros.
* Colaborar desde el Day 0 con Product Managers y Diseñadores para asegurar que las soluciones técnicas se alinean con la visión de producto y la experiencia de usuario.
* Impulsar nuestra cultura AI-native: integrar herramientas como Claude Code en el día a día del squad, contribuir a flujos de trabajo automatizados (tickets "claude-ready", revisión asistida, generación de PRs), y compartir aprendizajes con el resto de Engineering.
* Ser owner del roadmap técnico de tu dominio: identificar deuda técnica relevante, planificar refactors, definir SLOs y asegurar la observabilidad.
* Garantizar las mejores prácticas de seguridad, testing, rendimiento y CI/CD a lo largo del ciclo de vida del desarrollo.
* Contribuir a la estrategia de plataforma junto al Head of Engineering, participando en decisiones que afectan a toda la organización (infraestructura, estándares, governance de IA).
* Representar técnicamente a tu squad en foros cross-funcionales y reportar progreso a leadership con métricas accionables.

**Tech Stack**

* Backend: Python con FastAPI, arquitectura de microservicios orientada a dominios (DDD), APIs first.
* Frontend: TypeScript con React, Zustand (state management global), TanStack, React Router.
* Datos y mensajería: PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ (con Protocol Buffers para serialización de mensajes), Redis.
* Infraestructura y despliegue: AWS, EKS, ArgoCD, Helm, Terraform, KEDA, GitLab CI, Docker.
* Calidad: Testing automatizado (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Pytest), Security by Design.
* IA y productividad: Claude Code, CodeRabbit, y otras herramientas que iremos incorporando como parte de nuestra estrategia AI-native.

  
**Requirements**

**Qué necesitamos de ti:**

* 6+ años de experiencia en desarrollo de software, con 2+ años liderando equipos con personas a cargo (tech lead, engineering manager o similar).
* Fuerte experiencia full-stack o bien dominio profundo de uno de los dos lados (Backend con Python/FastAPI o Frontend con React/TypeScript) con fluidez demostrada en el otro.
* Experiencia diseñando e implementando arquitecturas de microservicios en producción, idealmente con enfoque Domain-Driven Design.
* Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL) y arquitecturas event-driven (RabbitMQ, Kafka u otros brokers).
* Experiencia escribiendo ADRs y liderando decisiones arquitecturales con trade-offs claros y documentados.
* Track record demostrable de mentoría técnica y elevación del nivel del equipo a través de code review, pair programming, o iniciativas de formación.
* Experiencia con CI/CD, despliegues en cloud (AWS preferido), Docker, y observabilidad en producción.
* Sólida comprensión de mejores prácticas de seguridad y testing a lo largo del ciclo de desarrollo.
* Experiencia trabajando con flujos de desarrollo asistidos por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot u similares) y disposición activa para liderar su adopción.
* Capacidad para colaborar cross-funcional con Product, Diseño y otros squads, y comunicar trade-offs técnicos a audiencias no técnicas.
* Comunicación fluida en español e inglés.

**Bonus**

* Experiencia previa en construction tech, PropTech, AEC, o herramientas BIM/IFC.
* Experiencia escalando equipos de ingeniería (procesos de hiring, onboarding técnico, definición de carreras).
* Experiencia con Kubernetes (EKS)
* Experiencia construyendo o integrando pipelines de IA en producto (LLMs, OCR, agentes).

  
**Benefits**

**Qué ofrecemos**

  

* Impacto real: formar parte de una empresa que está transformando la construcción hacia un modelo sostenible y positivo para el planeta
* Crecimiento profesional: plan de desarrollo individual con oportunidades de aprendizaje y formación continua
* Buen ambiente y colaboración: equipo multidisciplinar, diverso y con una cultura de apoyo y cercanía
* Bienestar y equilibrio: para nosotros es importante el balance entre tu vida personal y la profesional, por eso disfrutamos de dos días de teletrabajo a la semana
* Oficinas sostenibles: espacios agradables, pensados para la colaboración y el respeto medioambiental
* ️ 30 días laborables de vacaciones al año para que disfrutes de tu tiempo personal

*En 011h, fomentamos la diversidad y la inclusión. Todas las personas son bienvenidas, independientemente de su origen, identidad, orientación, edad o capacidad. Adaptamos el proceso si lo necesitas. Únete a un equipo que valora diferentes perspectivas y experiencias.*

title: Head of Content
description:
**About us**
============

At THEKER, we're taking on one of the greatest challenges of the 21st century: redefining how physical work gets done in the world.

We are a robotics and AI company building intelligent, adaptable systems that solve problems traditional automation never could. From Barcelona, our mission is to create a generation-defining company leading the robotics revolution.

By joining us, you will have the chance to do the most meaningful work of your life, setting a new standard for industrial automation and driving breakthroughs with global reach, while being surrounded by a focused, talent-dense team that shares this ambition and is here to win.

We recently closed the largest robotics Series A in Europe's history, and we're looking for the top 0.01% of talent to take on that mission with us, and build the biggest company in the world.

**Your role**
=============

We are looking for a Head of Content to run THEKER's content operation from request to delivery. You will receive what the company needs from marketing, decide what comes first and make sure it ships on time and on brand. This is an operations and management role with a strong eye for brand. You won't be designing or editing yourself, but you will know good work when you see it.

You will be the single point of contact for marketing requests across THEKER, from videos and photos to presentations and events. You will turn each request into a clear brief, assign it to the right person in the content team and follow it through to delivery. You will also own the materials our sales team uses with clients and keep them current and consistent.

Day to day, you will manage the team's timeline and keep several projects moving at once. You will work with the founders and with every team from engineering to sales. You will also track what each channel delivers and propose new actions, from trade fairs to formats we haven't tried yet. Success means every request has an owner and a date, and sales trusts every material it sends.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We are looking for a hybrid profile: part creative director, part motion designer, part AI-native creator and part team leader.

You should have:

* Strong experience in marketing or content, ideally B2B, including leading a creative team and giving clear, demanding creative direction.
* Strategic judgement. You set objectives, prioritize, and can explain why an action is worth doing.
* Strong brand and visual judgement, with deep knowledge of video and motion production. Your portfolio shows a point of view of its own.
* Solid copywriting in Spanish and English, plus comfort working with marketing metrics and analytics tools.
* A genuinely AI-native way of working. Claude should feel like your working environment, not an occasional tool.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate (100% on-site role).

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Knowledge of motion graphics or 3D.
* An AI-native way of working, with tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.
* Experience planning trade fairs and external events in industrial or tech sectors.
* A track record of turning complex technical products into content that non-technical audiences understand.

**You'll thrive at THEKER if**
------------------------------

* You're excited by a fast-paced and ambitious environment. The opportunity ahead of us is enormous, and we're going all in to capture it.
* You want responsibility early on, delivering at world-class standards for leading clients.
* You enjoy experimenting, iterating quickly, and embracing change as part of the learning process.
* You enjoy bringing order to many moving parts, and you're comfortable saying "not yet" when priorities require it.

**Main responsibilities**
=========================

* Own the single entry point for marketing requests from the rest of the company. Turn each one into a brief, prioritize it, assign it and track it to delivery.
* Manage the content team's calendar and coordinate internal and external collaborators on each project.
* Own every material that goes to GTM, from sales decks to product documentation, with clear versions and approvals.
* Act as the main contact for sales on what they need and what is out of date.
* Keep the message and the brand consistent in everything that reaches a client.
* Write and review copy for LinkedIn, presentations and product materials.
* Define the metrics for each channel and turn what they show into decisions.
* Choose and plan the trade fairs and external events we attend, and propose new channels and formats with a clear goal and a way to measure them.

**What we offer**
=================

* Being part of a fast-growing robotics and AI company with genuine ambition, where your career can accelerate alongside us.
* The chance to build THEKER's content function and decide how a robotics company should look and sound.
* A focused, talent-dense team where your work is visible and your decisions count.
* An environment where new ideas are encouraged and your contributions shape both the product and the company.
* 100% on-site work in Barcelona.

**What the process looks like**
===============================

* Intro call with Talent Team. 30 minutes.
* Portfolio review and a case study on a real THEKER content and marketing challenge.
* Conversation with the founding team.
* Meet the rest of the team and founders at our offices.

These steps can be completed in 7 days.

**Final observation**
=====================

We're committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome all applications regardless of background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, or beliefs.

* People & Talent

**What you will do**

As a **Senior HR Business Partner** at Lighthouse, you'll partner with directors, vice presidents and leadership teams across Revenue and Marketing to shape people strategy and turn business priorities into practical action. This is a hands-on advisory role, combining workforce redesign and talent development with performance management and complex employee relations. **Who you are**

* Credibility advising directors and vice presidents on people strategy, organisation design and workforce change, alongside hands-on performance management experience.
* Clear, concise communication and senior stakeholder influence, including the ability to present recommendations, challenge assumptions and maintain a constructive position under pressure.
* Data storytelling skills that connect signals across clusters, distinguish local issues from organisation-wide patterns and build a business case for action.
* Understanding of how artificial intelligence reshapes roles, team structures and capability needs, and the ability to guide leaders through workforce redesign decisions.

* Experience independently managing complex employee relations cases with significant business, legal or reputational dimensions, including knowing when to escalate or involve Legal.

**We welcome**

* Experience contributing to or designing HR frameworks, programmes or operating models.
* Familiarity with organisation design methods, including responsibility mapping, spans of control and role design principles.
* First-hand experience supporting a function through significant AI-driven transformation.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. ### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results
* Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury
* Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people
* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team
* A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture
* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Expansion Project Manager
description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Expansion Project Manager** to oversee the full expansion lifecycle for Impress, driving commercial growth through strategic partnerships and leading the delivery of flagship clinic construction projects worldwide. This role is responsible for identifying and closing real estate and B2B dental opportunities, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing CAPEX budgets, and executing end-to-end fit-out and site delivery.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Business Development & Real Estate Partnerships**

* Identify, prospect, and engage new real estate partners, including landlords, property owners, retail groups, and shopping centers.
* Pitch the Impress model to generate strong interest in hosting clinic locations.
* Build and manage an active pipeline of prospective sites, leading the full negotiation cycle through to contract signature.
* Develop and maintain an ongoing network of strategic partners, including landlords, commercial brokers, and investors.
* Represent Impress during meetings, site visits, and industry events to maximize expansion opportunities.

#### **2. Dental Partnership Development (B2B)**

* Prospect dental practices and orthodontists to establish strategic B2B partnerships.
* Present the Impress partnership model, tailor the pitch to partner needs, and execute agreements.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing partner practices to optimize ongoing collaboration.

#### **3. Construction & Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage flagship construction projects worldwide, owning each phase from design coordination and the tender process through construction, opening, and site handover.
* Manage the workload and output of regional teams involved in design and construction.
* Ensure all projects align with expansion forecasts, new opening schedules, and operational goals.
* Oversee the maintenance and remodeling of operational clinics to reflect strategic decisions, policy updates, and brand improvements.

#### **4. Budget Management**

* Build budgets prior to presentation to senior management for executive approval.
* Oversee comprehensive cost and budget management, evaluating and approving additional spending when necessary.

#### **5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with operations, finance, legal, marketing, and construction teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on expansion priorities and deadlines.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders (such as Country Managers and Medical Directors) to communicate regional needs, address requirements, and mitigate escalations.
* Escalate critical issues promptly to ensure all project milestones and opening dates are met.
* Identify potential operational, financial, or delivery risks early and implement corrective solutions.
* Deliver regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, contract negotiations, construction milestones, and upcoming clinic openings.

### **What you need to be successful:**

* Academic Background: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Industrial, Mechanical, Architectural, or related field).
* Experience: 5+ years in commercial real estate expansion, retail/network rollouts, or multi-site technical project management.
* Languages: **Native or Professional fluency in English** (additional languages are a plus).
* Mobility: **Willingness to travel frequently** for site visits, contractor inspections, partner meetings, and industry events.
* Commercial & Deal-Making Track Record: Proven background in B2B sales, real estate acquisition, lease negotiation, and partnership development with landlords, brokers, and healthcare professionals.
* End-to-End Project Delivery: Direct experience managing fit-outs and construction projects from initial design and tender to contractor oversight, site handover, and maintenance.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience formulating, tracking, and managing multi-site CAPEX budgets and construction cost accounts.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives, landlords, regional country managers, and medical directors.
* Project Management & Organization: Strong organizational skills with a track record of running parallel projects across multiple regions while hitting strict launch deadlines.

title: Store Manager Barcelona
description:
**Become our Store Manager and establish Hatstore in Barcelona**
----------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Help build Hatstore’s next international store**

2026 is an important year for Hatstore. Following our first international store launch, we’re taking the next step in our retail expansion and opening a new store in **Barcelona**.

Since launching in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Northern Europe’s leading e-commerce retailers for caps and headwear. Now we’re continuing to develop Hatstore as a brand and a place to meet, both offline and online. With our store in Barcelona, we want to create an inspiring destination for caps, fashion and a great customer experience.

For this exciting chapter, we’re looking for an **entrepreneurial, driven and hands-on Store Manager** who wants to help build our presence in Barcelona from the very beginning.

**About Hatstore**
------------------

Hatstore was founded on a genuine passion for caps, creativity and innovation—and those are still what drive us forward.

Today, we have more than 100 employees and sell to customers in 55 countries. Our range includes tens of thousands of caps, beanies and hats, including the option to create custom designs.

Our international retail expansion is an important part of Hatstore’s continued growth. We’re now looking for someone who wants to help make Barcelona an important part of our international store expansion.

**Your role as Store Manager**
------------------------------

As Store Manager of our new store in Barcelona, you’ll play a key role in establishing and developing Hatstore in the Spanish market.

You’ll be responsible for the store’s day-to-day operations, building and leading your team, and ensuring our customers have an experience that reflects the Hatstore brand.

You’ll also work closely with our head office in Sweden and be an important link between the local business and our international team.

This is an opportunity to be involved from the start, influence the way we work and lay the foundations for future Hatstore stores in other markets.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Store launch & development**  
Take part in planning, launching and developing our new store in Barcelona.

**Leadership & team**  
Recruit, onboard, develop and motivate the store team, and build a strong team culture.

**Sales & customer experience**  
Ensure a high level of service, create an inspiring store environment and actively work towards the store’s sales targets.

**Store operations & merchandise flow**  
Take responsibility for day-to-day operations, stock, merchandise flow, inventory and orders.

**Building the brand locally**  
Help build Hatstore’s local brand through social media, partnerships, events and other creative initiatives.

**Budget & performance follow-up**  
Manage the store’s budget and key performance indicators, and monitor and report results to our head office in Sweden.

**We believe you**
------------------

* Have experience in retail, for example as a Store Manager, shop manager, team leader or in a similar role
* Are a natural leader who enjoys developing people and building teams
* Have a strong customer focus and understand what makes a great in-store experience
* Are entrepreneurial, solution-oriented and used to taking responsibility
* Enjoy working hands-on and are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed
* Have a good understanding of retail and the local market in Barcelona
* Are comfortable with social media and enjoy creating content and building a brand
* Are proficient in English, as you’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden
* Are proficient in Spanish; Catalan language skills are an advantage
* Have a genuine interest in caps, fashion, sport and streetwear

You’re also someone who gets things done. You’re sociable, down-to-earth and confident in your leadership. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships, while also being clear and direct when needed.

An interest in American sports is an advantage, as a large part of our range is connected to MLB, NBA, NHL and NFL.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**A key role in Hatstore’s international expansion**  
You’ll be an important part of our continued international retail journey and help launch our new store in Barcelona.

**The opportunity to build something from the ground up**  
You’ll have plenty of scope to influence how the store develops, how the team works and how Hatstore establishes itself locally.

title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description:
**About us**
------------

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale.

**About this role**
-------------------

As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture**

* **Define European Hub Talent Strategy:** Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers.
* **Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative:** Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent.
* **Navigate Market Nuances:** Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks.

### **2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation**

* **High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence:** Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets.
* **End-to-End Pipeline Activation:** Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners.
* **Developer Platform Immersion:** Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement.

### **3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement**

* **Targeted Campaign Architecture:** Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines.
* **Technical EVP Translation:** Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors.
* **Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits:** Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion.

### **4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization**

* **Hiring-Centric Metrics:** Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill.
* **Budget Oversight:** Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver.
* **Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever):** Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration.

### **5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability**

* **Strategic Thought Partnership:** Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment.
* **Playbook Documentation:** Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets.
* **Mentorship & Functional Growth:** Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales.

**Experience & Background**
---------------------------

* **8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership:** Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines.
* **European Market Expertise:** Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain).
* **Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record:** Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper.
* **Fintech & Scale Exposure:** Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments.
* **International Collaboration:** Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* **Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation:** Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires.
* **Deep Engineering Domain Fluency:** Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences).
* **Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity:** High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
* **Strategic Campaign Design:** Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires).
* **Paid Digital Campaign Optimization:** Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion):** Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring.
* **First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry & Quick Wins):** Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles.
* **First 6 Months (Hub Establishment & Pipeline Ramp):** Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires.

Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers.

**Why join us**

title: Strategy & Transformation Specialist
description:
Quiénes somos

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor & Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.

We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.

Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1.8 billion passengers worldwide.

Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

**Qué esperamos**
-----------------

**Your mission :** Support the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office in defining, tracking and delivering the company’s strategic initiatives. You’ll provide high-quality analysis and reporting, and use data to challenge initiative owners so that initiatives move forward, are properly prioritised and deliver the expected impact.

**What you’ll do:**

**Analysis and reporting (c. 50%)**  
Half of your time will go into turning information into decisions. You’ll prepare the management reports, dashboards and materials that committees and senior leadership use to steer the business. You’ll also run ad hoc analyses whenever a strategic question comes up, from market sizing and benchmarks to business cases for new initiatives. Working closely with the Head of Strategy, you’ll help shape executive presentations that are clear, well-grounded and ready to support key decisions.

**Strategic initiative tracking (c. 50%)**  
The other half is about making sure strategy actually happens. You’ll manage the portfolio of strategic initiatives as you would a project, keeping a clear view of owners, milestones, KPIs, risks and status. You’ll meet regularly with directors and initiative owners, not just to collect updates but to ask the right questions: what is being done and why, what impact it is having, and what is holding progress back. When something goes off track, you’ll raise it with the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office, always bringing a proposal on how to get it back on course.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

You have 2–4 years of experience, ideally in strategy consulting, working on strategy, transformation or operations projects. You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a similar field, and your English is strong. A master’s degree is a plus, but not a requirement.

You’re highly analytical. You work comfortably with advanced Excel and build executive-level PowerPoint presentations, and experience with Power BI or an equivalent tool is highly valued. You know how to synthesise complex information and turn it into a clear, compelling storyline.

You’re also well organised. You track milestones rigorously and can manage several workstreams at once without losing sight of priorities.

Above all, you have the presence and confidence to challenge directors without creating friction. You’re results-oriented, proactive, and you don’t wait for problems to escalate before acting on them.

**Qué ofrecemos**
-----------------

* The opportunity to join an international team working on high-impact, technically demanding projects within the airport mobility sector.
* Hybrid working model: on-site in Mieres (Asturias) with partial remote work.
* Professional development within a specialized, expanding technical environment, as part of the TK Elevator group.
* Terms and conditions to be discussed based on candidate profile.

please, send your application via TKE careers web

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.
* Build and maintain automations, Make scenarios and AI agents (for example Claude skills and MCP connections, ClickUp agents and AI assistants) that handle repetitive coordination: assignment checks, delivery QA, content safety and duration checks, reporting, onboarding messages and sample tracking.
* Test new AI and agentic tools for operations and creative production, and recommend what to adopt, with clear costs, risks and expected time saved.
* Keep a registry of every running automation and agent, with its purpose, owner and schedule. Make sure each one is monitored, documented and that failures surface quickly.
* Train the team to run and trust these workflows, so they keep working without depending on the person who built them.

ClickUp workspace

* Own the marketing ClickUp workspace: structure, lists, statuses, templates, dashboards, permissions, forms and native automations. Serve as the escalation point for ClickUp issues.
* Keep the workspace practical, accurate and usable as team needs change, with consistent processes across internal teams and external partners.
* Make sure tasks hold the information needed for execution, reporting and accountability.

Notion and operational documentation

* Own the architecture and maintenance of the marketing Notion workspace, including operational databases such as the ads delivery and creator sample trackers.
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.
* Update documentation whenever workflows change, so essential knowledge is easy to find and does not depend on any one person.

Reporting and operational performance

* Own marketing operations reporting and the accuracy of the trackers behind it.
* Keep visibility into assignments, production, delivery, backlog, capacity, onboarding and operational risks. Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.
* Define and maintain operational KPIs and their calculations with the relevant stakeholders, such as creative lead time and on-time delivery. Flag missing or inconsistent data before using it to assess performance.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement improvements that speed up execution, reduce avoidable revisions and improve resource use.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own the operational administration of the marketing tool stack (including Higgsfield, HeyGen, Claude, Make, Tagbox and other creative and AI tools): access, onboarding, offboarding, usage tracking and vendor coordination.
* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.
* Review software needs with team leads, coordinate renewals and resolve access or usage issues. Cut unnecessary costs and identify tools that make production faster.
* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

* Own the administration and documentation of creative rewards programs.
* Maintain eligibility rules, performance trackers, milestone records and calculation procedures. Validate the monthly close with the relevant performance and finance owners before rewards are approved for payment.
* Resolve questions on naming, attribution, iterations and eligibility consistently. Escalate exceptions and proposed rule changes to leadership.

Hiring, onboarding and offboarding coordination

* Partner with the Head of People and functional leads to identify hiring needs based on capacity, workload and performance.
* Keep visibility into open roles, expected start dates, onboardings, exits and resource gaps, and share a regular hiring operations recap.
* Coordinate skills-test logistics for creative candidates with the reviewing leads.
* Prepare new joiners operationally: workspace access, onboarding checklists and ClickUp templates, pod and channel assignments, welcome messages and training resources.
* Oversee the marketing side of offboarding so access is removed across every tool and shared account, and responsibilities and files are handed over properly.
* People owns recruitment and formal HR processes. You own the operational readiness and integration of marketing hires.

Admin team management

* Lead the marketing operations admins. Set weekly priorities, clarify ownership and review the accuracy and completeness of assignment, delivery, reporting and access-management work.
* Keep dependable daily coverage so recurring work continues through absences and staffing changes. Own escalations and fix the process when the same issue comes back.

Leadership support and continuous improvement

* Give the CEO a clear view of operational health, risks, capacity and decisions required.
* Support planning for new products, brands, teams, partners and growth initiatives. Assess operational requirements, resource implications and execution risks before rollout.
* Keep visibility into vendor costs, rewards liabilities and resource allocation, and provide accurate operational inputs for budget and profitability decisions.
* Proactively spot broken or missing processes, and take approved improvements from diagnosis through implementation, documentation and team adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Marketing priorities have clear owners and realistic deadlines. Teams know what to work on, approved assets move steadily toward launch and blockers surface early.
* Every asset that reaches media buying has passed its quality, safety and duration checks, and delivery records match reality.
* Manual coordination keeps shrinking as reliable workflows, automations and AI agents take it over, and the team knows how to run them.
* Creator, affiliate and social media programs run on clear processes, with samples, content, rights and results tracked end to end.
* ClickUp, Notion, automations and trackers stay accurate and useful. Leadership can see production status, capacity and risks without chasing updates.
* New hires join prepared pods with the right access and onboarding, and leavers are offboarded cleanly. External partners follow clear delivery processes.
* Tool usage, Higgsfield credits, costs and rewards are tracked reliably and reconcile to source.
* After the handover, the function runs independently, with you as the central owner of daily coordination, systems and operational improvement.

  
**Requirements**

What we're looking for

* Experience owning marketing operations, creative operations or project operations in a DTC e-commerce business or performance marketing agency.
* Strong hands-on ClickUp skills, including workspace design, dashboards, templates and automations, and confidence building and maintaining Notion documentation.
* A clear understanding of creative production workflows, paid media delivery, retention operations and cross-functional campaign execution.
* Experience coordinating distributed, multi-time-zone teams, managing competing deadlines and holding internal teams and external partners accountable.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, operational reporting, software costs and performance data, and the ability to spot unreliable data and fix the tracking behind it.
* A track record of building workflows and integrating AI into operations (for example Make, Zapier, Claude, ClickUp AI or custom agents), from first idea to a process the team uses every day.
* Experience overseeing creator, affiliate or social media programs, or working closely with the teams that run them.
* Clear written communication, sound judgment and the confidence to make routine operational decisions on your own.

Nice to have

* Experience with AI creative tools such as Higgsfield or HeyGen, and with managing credit-based tool budgets.
* Hands-on experience running creator, UGC or affiliate programs, including sample logistics and commission tracking.
* Experience operating through BFCM or other high-volume launch periods.

Above all, we need someone who takes full ownership, follows through and builds systems the team can rely on.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive monthly rate based on experience and ability to move fast
* Fully remote — no fixed location, flexible setup
* Access to real performance data and learning from how the creative system actually works at scale
* Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production and operations infrastructure

title: Senior Talent Acquisition
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 consultants and experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace people; it elevates us to where no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will develop more than skills—you will cultivate judgment. Your expertise will deepen with every system you architect, client challenge you solve, and deployment that builds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

**What You'll Architect**

In this role, you combine advisory and sourcing skills, using AI-enabled tools and talent data to find, assess and attract the people who build intelligent systems for our clients.

* Partner with Managing Directors and senior stakeholders across Keyrus entities, turning business plans into clear hiring strategies backed by real market data

* Source, engage and attract top talent in Data, AI and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), with a primary focus on the French market and support for other EMEA markets when needed

* Recruit the profiles that power intelligent systems: AI and ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, data architects and AI consultants

* Use AI-enabled sourcing and talent intelligence tools (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI sourcing platforms, ATS automation) to identify and reach the right talent faster and more precisely

* Combine these tools with advanced human sourcing methods: headhunting, X-ray and Boolean search, growth hacking and deep networking

* Produce talent market insights on skills availability, salary trends, and competitor activity to guide where and how Keyrus hires

* Build and maintain talent pools in our core technologies, so entities can staff new client projects quickly

* Lead and deliver recruitment projects, managing the full recruitment cycle from intake to offer

* Run competency-based interviews that assess both technical depth in data and AI and consulting skills, with human judgment at the heart of every hiring decision

* Strengthening the Keyrus employer brand with data and AI communities through content, networking and community engagement

* Share your expertise in AI-enabled recruitment and help grow TA capabilities across the group

* You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, confident enough to challenge a brief with data and propose alternatives

* You are fluent in the language of data and AI, and understand the roles you recruit for well enough to have credible conversations with engineers and consultants

* You use technology to work smarter, and you know where automation adds value and where a human conversation makes the difference

* You thrive in a cross-border team, working remotely across countries, cultures and markets

* You build genuine, long-term relationships with candidates and stakeholders

* You keep improving how we recruit, and share what works with the wider team

**What You Bring**

Qualifications/Certifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business, **Psychology,** or a related field, or equivalent by experience

* 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with a headhunting background

Technical Skills

* Proven success sourcing and hiring technical profiles in Data, AI, and Digital

* Experience recruiting for the French market

* Advanced sourcing skills: headhunting, Boolean / X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter

* Hands-on use of AI-enabled recruitment and talent intelligence tools in your daily work

* Fluent English and French (written and spoken)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience recruiting in other EMEA markets

* Any additional language (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch)

* Background in Resource Management (in-house, MSP or RPO), ideally with nearshore/offshore recruitment experience

* Experience recruiting EPM profiles

* Experience with recruitment analytics and reporting dashboards

* Experience recruiting for consulting firms or professional services

**What Makes You Successful**

* Clear, persuasive communication with candidates and senior stakeholders across cultures

* The ability to influence hiring decisions with market data and a well-argued point of view

* Commercial awareness: you understand how a consulting business runs and why the right hire at the right time matters

* The judgment to combine AI-driven efficiency with personal, high-quality candidate experience

* High energy, curiosity and the drive to keep raising the bar on how Keyrus recruits

**Rewards – What We Offer at Keyrus**

* A full-time contract

* Benefits and package depending on your location

* A team that supports and guides you from day one

* Plenty of challenges and opportunities to keep developing your skills

* An environment built on trust, openness and collaboration

**What We Stand For**

* Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

* Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

* Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

* Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

**Our Hiring Process**

We keep our process clear and respectful of your time:

* Interview with the Intake Manager: a deep dive into your recruitment experience, sourcing approach, and use of AI and data in your work

* Initial conversation with the Intake team: to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about us

* Practical exercise: you walk us through your sourcing and market-mapping strategy for a Data & AI role

* Final conversation with Intake leadership

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. Designing the Operating System of an intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

* Intelligence Foundations,

* Human in Command governance,

* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 3,000 employees across 30 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.
