title: Solutions Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
This role manages product marketing for document databases (MongoDB), MySQL, and MariaDB.  
  
Percona is fully remote, and open source in our identity.

**Location**: Remote (EMEA or Americas preferred, for core-hours overlap with the team)

**Reports to**: Director of Solutions Marketing (Solutions Marketing is Percona's product marketing function)

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

Percona sells support, services, and expertise alongside database software. Our software and our services combine to provide users and customers with secure open source databases, free of vendor lock-in. On this team, we help communicate the value and relevance to the people involved in deciding to use our solutions. The right person for this role thinks in use cases and buyer needs, not only product features.

You don’t need to come from a product marketing background. If you've done technical content, developer relations, solutions engineering, or technical writing in the database or infrastructure space, and you can translate complex technology into clear messaging, we want to hear from you.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

Initial focus (document databases like MongoDB, MySQL, and MariaDB):

* Technical product messaging and positioning for Percona’s MongoDB related offerings, MySQL, and MariaDB support and expertise.
* Use case and value based messaging for all feature messaging for GTM
* Competitive positioning
* Partner with Services and Consulting so your messaging connects to the support, consulting, and managed services that customers actually buy alongside the software.

Across the portfolio (ongoing):

* Coordinate with Product on roadmap inputs for your portfolio areas. Translate VOC from support, consulting, and sales into positioning updates and product feedback
* Own launch plans for releases, features, and service offerings in your areas. Contribute to launches, enablement, and messaging that span multiple database technologies.
* Build and maintain competitive landscapes for your primary areas, and contribute to the broader Percona competitive view. Track ecosystem trends across your portfolio areas (community surveys, conferences, mailing lists, analyst reports).

* Build sales and CS enablement: competitive comparison docs, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQ docs, and other materials that connect technology to the use cases buyers care about.
* Engage with the open source database community. Represent Percona's perspective at events and in public content.

**Must-haves:**

* **Strong communicator.** Can write for technical buyers (DBAs, SREs, platform engineers) and economic buyers (VP Eng, CTO, CISO). Clear and concise internally too.
* **Stakeholder skills**. Builds trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services. Responsive, organized, follows through.
* **Technical foundation**. Comfortable in technical conversations about databases, infrastructure, and operations. Can learn complex technology quickly and translate it into clear messaging. **Can work in, or can** ***learn*** **to work in GitHub**. Understanding of use cases that drive these buyers: migrations, high availability, performance, cost, compliance, and AI or vector workloads.
* **Open source mindset.** Understands transparent work, respects community, and describes licenses honestly, including when software is source-available rather than open source. Has worked in or engaged with open source in some meaningful way.
* **Adaptable.** Willing to work across multiple database technologies when the team needs it.
* 3+ years in a technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, technical writing, or product marketing role. (The specific title matters less than what you've done.)

**How we work**
---------------

Percona is fully remote with a global team. Open source is the foundation: our software is built in the open where licenses allow, our community relationships are real, and transparency is the default.

You'll partner closely with teammates covering other database technologies and have direct access to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting

Occasional travel (3-6 events a year) for database community conferences, partner meetings, and internal offsites (for example Percona Live, KubeCon, and MySQL or MongoDB community events).

**Compensation**
----------------

Competitive with market for remote-first infrastructure and open source companies. Adjusted for location. We share the salary range for this role early in the conversation.

**Why Percona?**

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Market Development Manager — EMEA
description:
#### **About the Role:**

Hearing care is consolidating. Regional chains are becoming national ones, national ones are going multi-country, and most of them are still running on software that cannot take them there. Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide — no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.

**Your mandate:**

* **Market selection:** build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.
* **Market entry:** create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.
* **Demand:** turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.

#### **What You Will Do:**

* Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.
* EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.
* Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.
* Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.
* Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.
* Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.
* Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.
* Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.
* Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.
* Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.
* Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.
* A self-directed mindset: you will be creating this territory, not inheriting it.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Remote-first and async-friendly with a flat organizational structure.
* A modern IT environment: leading AI tools, HubSpot CRM and the means to automate your go-to-market.
* A real career path and leadership track, with development and certification support.
* A global, diverse team across 30+ nationalities.
* A product held to ISO 13485 and EU MDR, and a mission that matters: do this well and more people hear better, sooner.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

We look forward to your application! (***please submit your CV in English and a few lines on why this role interests you***)

*Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create a diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

title: Product Manager
description:
### **About our Crew**

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a **Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance** to join our Product team in Barcelona.

### **The role**

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our **monetization and compliance roadmap**. You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our **revenue and contribution margin**, while keeping the product compliant on **tax and invoicing**.

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with **finance, data, legal and operations**, with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

**The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers**, 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

### **What floats your boat**

* **Build a point of view:** you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).
* **Vision & Roadmap:** you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.
* **Compliance by design:** you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.
* **Data-driven decisions:** you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.
* **Decision making:** you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.
* **Fail fast, learn fast:** you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

### **What you bring aboard**

* Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.
* You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.
* A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.
* Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.
* You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
* Fluent or bilingual in English.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.
* Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.
* Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

### **The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.
* Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

### **️** **What awaits you on board**

* A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;
* Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;
* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;
* Team-building activities;
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract:** Permanent position

**Start date:** ASAP

### **Ready to join?**

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all.

title: Head of Product - AI x EdTech - French fluent
description:
**This isn’t another product job.**

**It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System** (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.

**Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.**

**A chance to build an AI-native Product Department**

You’ll be working with **the most complex data in the world : the human mind.**

**Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…**

* **Ambition around AI field :** Smart teammates driven to create an iconic, international product
* **Impact :** you strive to make a real difference in the company's growth, and not be a number in a big organization
* **Mission :** knowing your greatness left a mark in people's lives, through technology and behavioral science

**At Paradox, we believe that greatness is trainable.**

**That’s why** we want to empower people at scale by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

* **Human Intelligence** (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* **Structured Intelligence** (protocols, mental models, rituals),
* **Technological Intelligence** (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: **Paradox OS**.

**This is why we are looking for a Head of product to make Paradox a category-defining global brand loved for its product.**

This is a full-time position from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Paris or Lisbon or remotely anywhere in the world.

**OUR BELIEFS**
---------------

We believe self-help is broken.  
Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At **Paradox**, we believe people deserve more.  
More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a **system that knows them**, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that **every human learns differently**, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.  
It can **translate insight into transformation**, through **AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding**.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should **change how you live, think, and create.**

**OUR VISION**
--------------

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche - a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations *be our* marketing.

**OUR AI-NATIVE AMBITION**
--------------------------

We want to build an AI-native company, with agents in every department doing the work alongside our people.

In product, that means building a self-learning AI for product management: a system that learns from every user signal, experiment and release, and gets sharper at deciding what to build next.

For our clients, it means a self-learning AI that serves them through psychology and coaching, and gets better at helping each person change with every interaction.

You won’t just use AI tools: you’ll help design the agents, loops and feedback systems that make Paradox learn faster than anyone else.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

-

As **Head of Product**, you’ll be the **architect of a new category**, transforming growth into a living ecosystem powered by **AI, behavioral science, and design**.

You won’t just build features, you’ll **craft experiences that rewire behavior**.

You’re the **architect bringing clarity** between vision and execution, the person who turns “we should build this” into “it’s live, here’s the data and tangible impact.”

Every product cycle you lead will integrate:

* **Protocols** : guided frameworks grounded in psychology that rewire perception, emotion, and action.
* **Pods** : human connection, accountability, and shared rituals.
* **Loops** : adaptive, AI-powered coaching cycles that evolve with each user.
* **Personalization** : experiences that feel uniquely theirs, every time.

Going from a successful personal brand, to an international tech-driven iconic brand, is far from easy. It will be messy, chaotic - requiring constant iterations on MVPs and innovation in tech. Therefore to achieve this here are :

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

-

### **1. Make AI-native a way of building the company**

* Translate the founder’s strategic vision into a clear product strategy.
* Build and maintain the roadmap that connects business goals, user outcomes, and technological innovation.
* Ensure every feature supports the evolution of the Paradox ecosystem: Loops, PX Agents, Protocols, Membership.

### **2. User Understanding & Behavioral Insight**

* Be obsessed with user problems : talk to users weekly, analyze patterns, and identify where transformation breaks.
* Turn insights from behavioral science, coaching psychology, and learning design into actionable product hypotheses.
* Design loops, feedback, and rituals that make growth tangible.
* build for both the heart (inspiration) and the brain (structure).

### **3. Build, Ship, Learn Fast, create AI Loops**

* Apply Lean Startup methodology and scientific thinking to validate ideas through MVPs, not opinions.
* Design experiments and measurable success metrics before building.
* Iterate on a weekly basis on new hypothesis

### **4. AI Native Product Analytics & Impact Measurement**

* Define and track product success metrics (activation, retention, transformation rates).
* Connect data to business KPIs, know how your product drives lifetime value, not just engagement.
* We don’t track metrics just for internal dashboards, we track them also to prove transformation.
* Help marketing leverage this data to fuel authentic, evidence-based storytelling — showing the world *what real transformation looks like.*

### **5. Blend emotions (“open the heart of people”) with precision (“build loops, scoring, protocols”).**

* Create a visceral experience that translates into emotions of inspiration, awe from users.
* **Use a Science-backed, Cinematic, Contrarian style :** Every product touchpoint should be grounded in behavioral science, expressed with cinematic beauty, and challenge conventions

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**
-----------------------

-

**Experience :**

* 3–6 years as a Product Manager / Product Owner in EdTech, SaaS, or Consumer Tech.
* Bonus: experience in **AI-driven products**, **learning design**, or **personal development platforms.**
* You’ve shipped at least one major feature or product end-to-end, and can show measurable results.
* Uses Figma comfortably, prototypes directly.

**Traits :**

* **Craft-obsessed :** You get things done, you love to work much beyond 9-5, you have a doer mentality, a bias for outcomes and want to be a beast in your field
* **User & Impact Obsessed:** You think in outcomes, not outputs, you care about transformation.
* **Analytical & System Thinker:** You can turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, metrics, and roadmap.
* **Digital & AI savvy :** you’re able to build AI Agents (if not, you demonstrate ability to learn while applying).
* **Cross-disciplinary Curiosity:** You speak both tech and human; You can move from **vision to spreadsheet to Figma**

### **Language**

**French** : native

**English**: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

-

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.  
If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.  
If you build to deliver, not to *elevate* — wrong mission.

Surface-level Vision Alignment : you like the idea of Paradox but doesn’t want to *get* the depth. Paradox is design-led; you must *touch the product*, not just manage it.

If you’re obsessed with systems, psychology, and design…  
If you dream of using AI to amplify what makes us human…

**WHY JOIN US**

Build a product that fuses **neuroscience, design, and AI** to reinvent how humans grow.

The chance to build a product that could redefine human potential.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the **100 000 Dreams Wall**,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

### ***Growth & Ambition***

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

-

To complete the recruitment process, **each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply**

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**

That job description resonated with you?

title: Chief Customer Officer
description:
**Work from anywhere, impact everywhere**
-----------------------------------------

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
  
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.  
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
  
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
  
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  
Work from anywhere!

**Position overview**
---------------------

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

**The mandate**
---------------

* **Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.**
    
  You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.

* **Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.**
    
  You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.

* **Win the right members, efficiently.**
    
  You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.

* **Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.**
    
  Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.

* **Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.**
    
  You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.

* **Build one Customer organisation, not four.**
    
  Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.

* **Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.**
    
  You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

**How you'll operate**
----------------------

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

* **You lead from inside the work.** You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
* **You move people with the business case, not the whip.** When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
* **You have extreme ownership.** You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
* **You have genuine gravitas.** Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
* **You diagnose before you prescribe.** You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

**What you'll have done**
-------------------------

* 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
* Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
* Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
* Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
* Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
* Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
* A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

  

**The first 90 days**
---------------------

**Day 30:** The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.  
**Day 60:** The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.  
**Day 90:** At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
* Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
* Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
* Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

**Other requirements**
----------------------

* A dedicated workspace.
* A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
* Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

**Why work for Xapo?**
----------------------

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

* **Shape the Future**  
  Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.
* **Great work-life balance**  
  Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.
* **Expect Excellence**  
  Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

title: Sr. Social Compliance Auditor
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

Would you like to develop professionally in our Compliance area by ensuring that our global operations and supply chain meet ethical standards, human rights requirements, and social responsibility commitments?

### **Job responsibilities**

  

**Your role will be:**

* Supplier onboarding
* Conducting on-site social compliance audits of suppliers and manufacturing partners
* Assessing supplier compliance with the LVMH Code of Conduct
* Identifying potential risks within the supply chain and documenting irregularities
* Analyzing risk patterns and trends across the supply chain
* Developing and implementing Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs in collaboration with other departments

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience as a Social Auditor in an international audit firm
* Certification: certified by recognized auditing bodies (e.g.: SA8000, SMETA, APSCA)
* Knowledge of labor legislation and human rights regulations
* Ethical judgment, risk assessment, data verification, and compliance evaluation across social, environmental, and governance areas
* C1 level of English and Spanish
* Willingness to travel

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Global Social Media Specialist
description:
### **Position**

The Global Social Media Specialist reports directly to the Head of Global Media and Social Media, collaborating closer with other functions and departments including global and local Marketing teams.

This role acts as a key point of contact for regional Marketing teams, ensuring alignment between global social media strategy, content creation, planning and local marketing execution.

**Your Mission:**

To manage and execute LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social media presence, ensuring a consistent, distinctive and engaging brand expression across international markets and platforms.

The role combines global social media management, editorial calendar ownership, creative content ideation, trend analysis and global coordination.

The Global Social Media Specialist will play a key role in identifying social media trends, defining content opportunities and translating platform insights into clear, actionable creative briefs for the Creative and Content teams.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of social media culture with a refined aesthetic sensibility, ensuring that LOEWE Perfumes’ unique creative universe is translated into relevant, innovative and platform-specific storytelling while preserving the brand’s luxury positioning.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Global Social Media Management & Editorial Planning**

* Manage day-to-day execution of LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social channels, ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, tone of voice and content quality.
* Own the global editorial calendar, aligning brand priorities, launches, campaigns, cultural moments and key marketing initiatives.
* Oversee end-to-end content planning: identify needs, define Creative briefs, coordinate asset delivery with internal stakeholders, schedule, publish and track performance.
* Translate global campaign storytelling into platform-specific content to maximize relevance and engagement.
* Evolve the brand’s organic presence through new formats, creative approaches, and platform developments.
* Monitor audience conversations, emerging trends and community sentiment, identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement and stronger brand affinity.
* Gather community insights to inform content planning and creative recommendations.

**Creative Content Ideation**

* Identify emerging trends, cultural conversations, formats, and content opportunities relevant to LOEWE Perfumes.
* Develop original, innovative, social-first ideas that translate the brand universe into engaging, platform-specific storytelling, including content beyond global campaign assets.
* Define creative and actionable briefs for Creative and Content teams, covering objectives, key messages, storytelling, formats and platform requirements.
* Partner with these teams throughout development to optimize creative execution for each platform.
* Contribute a social media perspective to brainstorming, campaign planning and content reviews; continuously evolve the content approach through creativity, cultural awareness and performance insights.

**Global & Regional Social Media Coordination**

* Act as a key contact between HQ and regional teams, aligning organic social media planning, content and define guidelines.
* Coordinate global calendars and content deployment across markets, including Asian channels (WeChat, RED, Weibo, Douyin, LINE, KakaoTalk)
* Support reviews of regional calendars, creative proposals and local adaptations, ensuring alignment with global strategy and approval processes.
* Facilitate HQ–regional communication and content sharing for efficient workflows and timely execution.
* Monitor international social media developments, particularly in Asia, to identify trends, best practices and brand opportunities.
* Contribute to global social media guidelines and content frameworks.

**Social Media Performance & Optimization**

* Analyze organic performance across global platforms, including reach, engagement, audience growth, video views and content effectiveness.
* Produce regular reports with actionable insights to improve content and channel performance.
* Benchmark competitors and track developments across luxury, beauty and digital culture, translating findings and performance insights into creative recommendations and content opportunities.
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic content amplification opportunities and align paid and organic initiatives.
* Support testing of new formats, creative approaches, and platform features.

### **Profile**

**Hard Skills**

* Proven experience managing organic social media channels for international or global brands, including content planning, editorial calendar management and publishing.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Instagram and TikTok, including platform-specific content formats, best practices and audience behavior.
* Previous experience or demonstrated working knowledge of Asian social media platforms, particularly WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), Weibo, Douyin, LINE and/or KakaoTalk.
* Experience coordinating content calendars, campaigns and social media activities across multiple markets or regional teams.
* Strong ability to identify social media trends and translate them into relevant content concepts, creative directions and actionable briefs.
* Proven experience collaborating with Creative and Content teams on content ideation, briefing, development and execution.
* Strong understanding of social-first storytelling, short-form video formats and platform-specific creative best practices.
* Ability to assess creative content from both a brand positioning and social media performance perspective.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, listening and analytics tools.
* Strong understanding of organic social media KPIs and performance reporting.
* Awareness of digital culture, emerging social media trends and luxury industry best practices.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong creative instinct and refined aesthetic sensibility, with a deep understanding of luxury brand codes.
* Ability to translate social media insights into relevant creative opportunities.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple content streams, deadlines and stakeholders.
* Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, particularly in multicultural and international environments.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Curious, culturally aware and passionate about social media, luxury, beauty and digital storytelling.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Approachable, inclusive and collaborative.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communication, Digital Media or similar
* 2–4 years of experience in social media, digital marketing
* Demonstrated experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating social media content across multiple markets.
* Previous experience developing content concepts and creative briefs in collaboration with Creative and Content teams.
* Experience or strong familiarity with Asian social media ecosystems, with an understanding of how content strategies and platform dynamics differ from Western markets.
* Experience in luxury, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
* Proven examples of social media projects demonstrating editorial planning, creative ideation and collaboration with creative teams.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is highly valuable; additional languages, particularly Asian languages, are a plus.

### **Additional information**

*LOEWE Perfumes represents the organic part of LOEWE. We are the unique Maison that crafts* *collectable botanical art pieces* *connected with nature in its purest form.*

*LOEWE Perfumes respects diversity and promotes inclusion from its recruitment process. We are committed to create an integrative working environment where all talents and singularities are engaged and valued.*

***LOEWE PERFUMES*** 
**MAISON**
--------------------------------

LOEWE Perfumes adds a multisensory dimension to LOEWE via a kaleidoscopic range of iconic fragrances for men, for women and for the home that combine vibrant, nature-inspired olfactory experiences with bold visual expression.
  
In 1972, LOEWE launched its first women’s fragrance: L de Loewe. Because of its success, the House began investing in international perfumery retail. LOEWE Perfumes has kept sustaining the brand’s Spanish legacy, artisanal savoir-faire and innovative spirit guided, since 2013, by the creative vision of Jonathan Anderson, LOEWE’s Creative Director, in partnership with in-house perfumier, Nuria Cruelles.
  
Encompassing the Botanical Rainbow—nine iconic fragrance families that translate the depth and variety of Nature’s inspiration into the medium of perfume—and LOEWE Home Scents—twelve plant portraits capturing the authentic essences of a vegetable garden—plus the ever-expanding, hedonistic Paula’s Ibiza fragrance families and the Un Paseo Por Madrid collection, LOEWE Perfumes creates a multisensory kaleidoscope of colour, scent and emotion, inspired by nature.

title: Client Data & Insight Manager
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

Are you passionate about client behaviour, data and luxury fashion? Join LOEWE as a Client Data & Insight Manager and turn client data into insights that help shape business decisions across our global organisation. Working closely with global and regional teams, you will identify trends, uncover opportunities and translate data into clear recommendations that help us better understand our clients and strengthen business performance.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Analyse client data from different sources to identify trends, understand client behaviour and uncover business opportunities.

* Monitor client performance across markets, collections and client segments, delivering regular reports, dashboards and ad hoc analyses.

* Ensure the quality and reliability of client data, KPIs and reporting, helping teams make informed decisions with confidence.

* Turn complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations that support commercial, CRM, clienteling and strategic priorities.

* Prepare and present insights to senior management and key stakeholders, adapting your message to different audiences.

* Partner with global and regional teams to understand business needs and provide relevant insights that support decision-making.

* Connect data with market trends, client expectations and local specificities to identify opportunities for business improvement.

* Contribute to a more data-driven culture by sharing best practices, improving reporting approaches and exploring new tools and methodologies.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* A degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is a plus.

* Significant experience in data analytics, client insights, business intelligence or a similar role, ideally within luxury, fashion, retail or consumer-focused industries.

* Strong experience in client behaviour analysis, performance reporting and data visualisation.

* Solid SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI. Knowledge of BigQuery is a plus.

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets and translate findings into business recommendations.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and relevant to different audiences.

* A collaborative and proactive mindset, with the ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and build relationships with stakeholders across regions and functions.

* A genuine interest in luxury, fashion, client behaviour and cultural differences across markets.

* Fluent English is required; Spanish is a strong plus.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

**Manager, Strategy & Execution**

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

  

**What your day will look like**

As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

* Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days
* Developing a methodology to define future market roles
* Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency
* Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period
* Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board
* Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution
* Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

* Project managing complex, cross-functional projects
* Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)
* Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions
* Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations
* Running workshops with senior leaders
* Building slide decks to tell a compelling message
* Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)
  

**What you’ll bring**

* You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience
  + Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus
* Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward
* Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors
* Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail
* Strong stakeholder management and team working experience
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel
  + Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus
  + Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus
* Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging
* A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you
* Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs
* Professionally fluent in English
  

**What you’ll learn**

* There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching
* This could include:
  + Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector
  + Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way
  + Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success
  + Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization
* This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite
* Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too
  

**Working at STG & What to expect**

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

**Our recruitment process**

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which will likely follow the following steps:

* Recruiter Screen

* Team Interview

* Behavioural Assessment

* Leadership Interview with case study

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover **so much more.**

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

* Set clear expectations, run a weekly performance rhythm with your Team Leads and partners, and act fast when results slip
* Make the tough calls when needed - on performance, staffing and priorities

**Lead the leaders**

* Manage, coach and develop our Team Leads in Málaga, building a leadership team that sets a high standard and holds each other accountable
* Potentially lead one market team directly at first, and stay close to the work by regularly handling cases yourself
* Build a culture of ownership, independent judgement, and pride in the work, with a clear development path for advisors from junior to senior

**Get the best out of our partners**

* Share accountability with our Workforce Management team for partner performance: help define performance targets, train and coach partner teams on their floors, and funnel partner feedback to our enablement teams so root causes get fixed
* Spend time on site with them, review quality together, and reduce escalations that bounce back to the in-house team
* Contribute to partner selection, onboarding and incentive design

**Fix how we work**

* Spot and remove friction on the front line: unnecessary escalations, duplicated work and outdated processes
* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

**Life at Holidu**

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram@lifeatholidu
