title: Biology Lab Research Support Technician
description:
ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences is a world-leading research center devoted to advancing the science and technologies of light. Based in Castelldefels, Barcelona, ICFO combines frontier research, education, innovation and technology transfer to generate scientific and societal impact.

Over the past two decades, ICFO has established itself as an internationally recognized center of excellence and a global reference in photonics. Today, with a highly international community of around 500 employees representing more than 70 nationalities, ICFO continues its institutional development aimed at strengthening scientific excellence, organizational effectiveness and long-term impact.

As a public research institution, ICFO is governed by a Board of Trustees and led by an Executive Leadership comprising the Director and the Managing Director, who are responsible for the scientific, strategic and operational development of the Institute.

ICFO is seeking a **Biology Lab Research Support Technician** to join its Biology Lab.

**Position Overview**

The main responsibilities of the Biology Lab Technician will have two components:

* operation and organization of the Laboratories and common areas of the Unit, and
* provide support to the research activity of Lab users.

**Key Responsibilities**

The main responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to) the following:

1. Supporting tasks in the management of the Facility:

* Assist in the registration, control and maintenance of the inventory of biological samples (mammalian cells, microorganisms, worms, model organisms, antibodies, etc.) of the Unit.
* Assist in the purchasing process, registration, supervision and maintenance of the inventory of laboratory consumables, media, reagents and chemicals, safeguarding their correct handling and storage.
* Organization and service of laboratory equipment as well as the glassware and plastic items.
* Handling and management of the biological and chemical waste generated in the Unit.
* Assist with the permanent training activities to Biology Lab users regarding safety and biosafety regulations.
* Assist with the permanent training activities regarding the use of equipment, handling of biological samples and chemicals,
* Development, implementation and vigilance of routine protocols oriented to ensuring the correct handling and disposal of biological and chemical waste generated in the Lab.

  
2.- Research support responsibilities:
  

* Perform routine culture and maintenance of mammalian cell lines, microorganisms and other model organisms.
* Perform routine breeding tasks and basic research procedures involving living animals.
* Assist in tasks related to the preparation and sterilization of culture media, buffers, reagents and additives.
* Perform routine protocols of classic and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques for cloning, extraction, purification and characterization of DNA and proteins.
* Preparation of samples for high-resolution microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Perform routine tasks related to the culture, handling and storage of C. elegans and other model organisms.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or similar).
* Updated official credential to work with experimental living animals (Projects and Procedures Design Function. RD 53/2013).
* Minimum B2 English Level.
* Minimum 2+ year experience in a similar position, preferably in an international research and/or academic environment.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience in classical and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques.
* Hands-on experience in microorganisms and mammalian cell culture techniques.
* Hands-on experience in model organisms (mainly C. elegans) culture and handling.
* Hands-on experience in preparation of biological samples for microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Experience in breeding and handling living animals, as well as experience in performing basic procedures involving living animals (euthanasia, surgery, dissection, etc.)

**Personal Competencies**

The successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Service orientation, initiative, proactivity, attention to detail, organizational commitment, and teamwork mentality.
* Strong organizational, planning and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-evolving international research environment.
* Strong communication skills.

**What ICFO Offers**

At ICFO, we offer the opportunity to contribute to the scientific, strategic and organizational development of one of the world’s leading research institutions.

The position provides:

* a highly stimulating and international research environment;
* meaningful responsibility and autonomy;
* competitive conditions commensurate with experience and qualifications;
* a unique location in Barcelona, one of Europe’s leading scientific, cultural and innovation hubs.

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

**Conditions**

The contract offered will be a permanent contract for scientific and technical activities (ACT).
  
This is a full-time position.
  
A probationary period of 6 months will apply, in accordance with ICFO’s internal labor regulations and the applicable public-sector labor framework.
  
A salary according to ICFO’s approved salary scales will be offered, commensurate with the level of the position and the candidate’s experience.

**Application Process**

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,
* a cover letter outlining your experience,
* contact information for 2 professional references.

Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. Candidates are assessed exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, experience, skills, achievements, and potential in relation to the requirements of the position. Further information on the recruitment principles and procedures, conflict of interest and the appeals mechanism available to candidates, can be found in the OTM-R Policy.

The selection process will consist of:

1. Eligibility check of applications
  
2. Assessment of merits (education, experience, and language)
  
3. Written test for pre-selected candidates to assess technical knowledge related to the job position
  
4. Interview with shortlisted candidates

The Evaluation Committee will include at least three members and ensure gender balance and impartiality.

Each phase will be documented, and candidates will be notified of the outcome within 15 days of the interview.

**Data Protection**

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018, ICFO informs applicants that their personal data will be processed exclusively for recruitment purposes.

* Controller: Fundació ICFO – Institut de Ciències Fotòniques, Av. Carl Friedrich Gauss 3, 08860 Castelldefels (Barcelona).
* DPO: dpo@icfo.eu
* Legal basis: performance of a task in the public interest.
* Rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, and opposition.
* Supervisory authority: Catalan Data Protection Authority (APDCAT) https://apdcat.gencat.cat.

All recruitment files will be retained in accordance with the Catalan public-sector archival retention schedule (DOGC 2117).

title: Security Manager (Temporal)

description:
**Everything you are looking for and more**

At InPost, we are looking for a Security Manager to lead and drive our security strategy across Spain and Portugal, ensuring the protection of our people, assets, facilities and operations.

Reporting to the Security Director Iberia, you will play a key role in strengthening security standards across our network, managing risks and ensuring business continuity in a dynamic logistics environment. You will oversee physical and electronic security, lead security teams and external providers, manage the departmental budget, and ensure compliance with applicable legislation and InPost Group standards.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational responsibility, including security systems management, incident investigations, site audits and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Based in San Fernando de Henares (Madrid), you will travel frequently across Spain and Portugal, covering approximately 50% of the Iberian territory. Availability outside regular working hours and on-call support will also be required.

**What responsibilities and objectives will you have?**

* **Security Strategy & Risk Management:** Define and implement the security strategy for the assigned Iberian territory, aligned with InPost Group objectives. Identify, assess and mitigate risks across facilities, transportation and operational processes, ensuring business continuity and resilience.
* **Team Leadership & Workforce Management:** Lead, develop and coordinate security specialists, security guards and auxiliary personnel. Manage workforce planning, schedules, shift coverage, substitutions and team allocation to ensure service continuity and operational efficiency.
* **Budget & Provider Management:** Prepare and monitor the annual security budget, optimising costs without compromising protection. Act as the main point of contact for external security providers, overseeing service levels, performance, contractual requirements and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Physical & Electronic Security:** Ensure that warehouses, operational hubs and other facilities meet InPost's minimum security standards. Oversee the design, implementation, commissioning and maintenance of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, alarm and intercom systems, ensuring reliability, interoperability and availability across all sites.
* **Security Systems Administration:** Administer security platforms across the network, including user permissions, access rights, system audits and periodic health checks. Apply basic IP networking knowledge to support connectivity between sites and security devices.
* **Governance & Compliance:** Ensure compliance with applicable Spanish, Portuguese and EU legislation, corporate security policies and relevant international standards, including TAPA and ISO. Develop and implement security procedures, policies and projects across the assigned territory.
* **Audits & Continuous Improvement:** Plan and conduct security audits across facilities, identify gaps, implement corrective action plans and monitor progress. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to incident reduction, audit compliance, service quality and system availability.
* **Incident & Crisis Management:** Lead incident reporting, assessment, investigation and resolution, coordinating root cause analysis and corrective actions. Manage critical security incidents, coordinate investigations and ensure timely communication with relevant stakeholders. Act as a 24/7 security point of contact for the assigned network.
* **Institutional Relations:** Coordinate with law enforcement agencies, judicial authorities and regulatory bodies, managing official requests and supporting investigations when required.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Operations, Transportation, Quality, IT, Loss Prevention and Facility Management to embed security into everyday processes and protect the entire logistics value chain.
* **Reporting & Stakeholder Management:** Prepare executive reports and communicate security performance, risks, incidents and improvement plans to regional and Group leadership, ensuring clear and effective communication in Spanish and English.

**Well, what will the requirements be?**

* At least 3–5 years of experience in senior security roles, preferably within logistics, retail or large-scale physical security operations.
* University degree in Security, Criminology, Engineering, Law or a related field.
* Valid Spanish Director de Seguridad (TIP) licence is required.
* At least 4 years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring and administering CCTV, access control and intrusion detection systems.
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing security budgets and coordinating external security providers.
* Strong knowledge of security risk assessment, incident investigation, crisis management, business continuity and corrective action planning.
* Working knowledge of basic IP networking to troubleshoot connectivity between sites and security devices. Experience managing security systems across multiple facilities is highly valued.
* Knowledge of private security legislation and relevant security standards, such as TAPA and ISO 28000.
* Proficiency in Excel for data analysis and reporting. Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools is an advantage.
* High level of English (C1) and fluent Spanish, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, international teams and external authorities.
* Strong leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills, with a proactive approach to risk prevention, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to travel frequently across Spain and Portugal (approximately 40%, typically 2–3 trips per month) and provide out-of-hours and on-call support.

***Nice to have***

* ASIS CPP/APP, TAPA, ISO 28000 or other relevant security certifications.
* Wicklander–Zulawski training or other investigation-related qualifications.
* Training in crisis management and emergency response.
* A Master's degree in Private Security or Security Management.
* Experience in logistics environments or dedicated corporate physical security departments.

**What do We Offer?**

* Language platform

* Wellbeing programme

* Flexible working hours

* Online platform for lifelong learning

* Competitive salary

* Flexible remuneration services can be contracted

**Why join us?**

At InPost, you will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with last-mile delivery solutions. You will work in a fast-growing, innovative environment where your contributions directly support the company’s expansion and market presence. Our culture is built around five key behaviours, driven by a strong “Go Go Go” mindset focused on speed and determination.

* **CHAMPION THE CUSTOMER:** We put the customer at the center of everything we do and strive to exceed expectations.

* **OWN IT:** We take responsibility, act with initiative, and proactively drive solutions.

* **DARE TO DISRUPT:** We embrace innovation, ambition, and continuous learning to grow and improve together.

InPost has an Equal Opportunities Plan that promotes equality at all levels. We aim for equality in the company's workplaces, focused on promotion, as well as gender equality, diversity, equity and inclusion of people regardless of their abilities and conditions.

**ZEST Ibiza | Full-time | On-site**

**Bring ZEST to life**

ZEST is a new five-star resort opening in Ibiza in 2027. Set above San Antonio, the resort will bring together the island’s vibrant energy and a more relaxed side of luxury, with distinctive places to stay, restaurants and bars, wellness and memorable experiences.

We’re looking for a creative, digitally minded Marketing Manager to help introduce ZEST to the world, build our presence in the market and turn awareness into bookings.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you’ll help deliver the resort’s marketing strategy from pre-opening through to launch and beyond. You’ll work closely with the Director of Marketing, General Manager, resort teams and specialist agencies to create effective campaigns and a consistent ZEST experience across our digital channels.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Digital marketing and performance**

* Coordinate day-to-day digital marketing activity with our paid media, SEO and website partners.
* Manage and update the ZEST website, keeping content accurate, engaging and optimised for search and conversion.
* Monitor website traffic, campaign performance, direct bookings and return on ad spend, identifying ways to improve results.
* Support CRM and email marketing, including database growth, guest communications and automated campaigns.
* Maintain clear performance reporting and help ensure analytics, tracking and marketing platforms are working effectively.

### **Social media and content**

* Manage the social media calendar and coordinate content across our channels.
* Plan photography, video shoots and other content production with creative partners and resort colleagues.
* Track social media performance, engagement and audience growth.
* Organise and maintain the resort’s photography, video and creative asset library.

### **Brand, campaigns and partnerships**

* Ensure marketing activity reflects ZEST’s identity, positioning and tone of voice.
* Coordinate campaigns for the resort’s accommodation, restaurants, bars, wellness and experiences.
* Support partnerships with relevant lifestyle, hospitality and local brands.
* Coordinate marketing collateral and support PR, media and influencer activity.

### **Marketing coordination**

* Manage the marketing calendar, project timelines and delivery of agreed activity.
* Be a key contact for digital, creative, social and PR agencies, helping keep projects on time and within budget.
* Work with the Director of Marketing, General Manager and wider resort team to align marketing with commercial priorities.
* Monitor marketing expenditure, obtain supplier quotes and support budget management.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Four to six years’ marketing experience, ideally in luxury hospitality, travel or lifestyle.
* Strong knowledge of digital marketing, including paid media, SEO, website management, analytics and CRM.
* Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and email marketing platforms.
* A good understanding of social media, content production and brand marketing.
* Commercial awareness and confidence using data to spot opportunities and improve performance.
* Strong project management, communication and organisational skills.
* Fluency in English and Spanish; additional languages would be an advantage.
* The ability to work on site in Ibiza. Knowledge of the island’s luxury hospitality and lifestyle scene would be helpful.
* Experience supporting a hotel opening or brand launch would be an advantage.

**Who you are**
---------------

You’re creative, digitally minded and commercially aware. You’re comfortable working with agencies, colleagues and senior stakeholders, and you take ownership of the details that turn a good idea into effective marketing.

You’re excited by Ibiza, hospitality and the opportunity to help build a new resort and brand from the ground up.

description:
**Job**
-------

Producer

**Description**
---------------

**About the Company**

As the world’s leading multidisciplinary service provider, Deluxe underpins the media and entertainment industry, servicing content creators and distributors including Netflix, WarnerMedia, The Walt Disney Company, Amazon, Apple, Viacom, NBCU, Google, AT&T and many others, by providing Global Content Distribution, Localization, Accessibility and Mastering while leading end-to-end innovation with unparalleled scale and agility across the Streaming, Theatrical, Broadcast and Mobile landscapes. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices around the globe, the company employs over 3,500 of the most talented and experienced industry individuals worldwide. For more information, please visit www.bydeluxe.com

**Position**: Producer

**Full-Time, Permanent Position**

**Location:** On site - Madrid

**Hours/Shifts**: 40 hours– 3 pm – 11pm

**Position Overview**

Coordinate the day-to-day production of assigned graphics localization projects for audiovisual marketing content, including trailers, TV spots and other campaign assets. The Producer will work closely with graphics artists, account management and post-production teams to ensure that briefs are clear, work follows agreed production plans and deliverables meet the required quality standards and deadlines.

The Producer will manage assigned projects independently, working with the Senior Producer on complex requirements, competing priorities and escalations.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Manage assigned graphics localization projects from briefing through to delivery, following agreed production plans and workflows.
* Review incoming requests and ensure that source materials, instructions, specifications and deadlines are complete and clearly understood.
* Plan and monitor assigned projects within agreed priorities and resource allocations, flagging scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns early.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with internal teams and client contacts, providing updates and flagging risks or issues early.
* Track assets, versions, feedback and approvals to ensure that everyone works with the correct materials and latest instructions.

title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

* **Competitive Starting Salary** with an **annual discretionary bonus**that truly rewards your performance from day one.
* **Dedicated Mentorship:** Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

* **Dynamic & Supportive Culture:** Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

* **Central** **Madrid** **Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.**

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.
* Build internal capability in advanced modelling techniques, external data utilisation, and pricing technology tools running knowledge-sharing sessions and supporting technical upskilling.
* Foster a high-performance pricing culture grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness, and a drive for continuous innovation.
* Identify and develop talent within the team; support succession planning aligned with Allianz Partners' people strategy and the RSA pricing function's long-term growth.

What you will bring
  
  
EXPERIENCE BACKGROUND
  
  

* 10+ years in pricing, actuarial, or underwriting roles with deep expertise in PC or assistance/travel insurance pricing.
* Minimum 3 years leading a pricing function, with direct management of international teams of 5+ FTEs.
* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, or comparable GLM/ML actuarial platforms.
* Demonstrated track record integrating external data sources and third-party platforms into pricing models in a production environment.
* Experience presenting pricing strategy and modelling outcomes to CRO, CFO, or Board-level stakeholders.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage given the global scope.

TECHNICAL MODELLING SKILLS
  
  

* Expert-level command of GLM-based rating engine development; proficiency in GBMs, Random Forests, and other ML techniques applied to insurance pricing.
* Hands-on with WTW Radar and/or Emblem for rate relativities, model fitting, and scenario testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for pricing analytics, model automation, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) and their application to insurance pricing pipelines.
* Experience with external data integration: geo-spatial data (e.g., Verisk, CoreLogic), medical cost databases, telematics feeds, open weather/climate APIs, and socio-demographic enrichment layers.
* Knowledge of pricing optimisation and elasticity modelling techniques, including demand modelling and customer lifetime value frameworks.
* Solid grounding in actuarial concepts: profit testing, reserving, reinsurance structures, and PL interpretation (GWP, NEP, loss ratio, CoR).

EDUCATION
  
  

* Degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Actuarial qualification or progress toward one (FIA, FCAS, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

title: Managing Tech Lead - Europa Universalis V
description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

**Practical information**
-------------------------

Scope: Full-time and permanent

Location: Sitges, Barcelona (Spain)

WFH/WFO: 100% onsite

Reports to: Head of Operations

Additionally, will support the head of the function, jointly with other Data Integration Solution architects, on the strategical vision of new Data Integration & Interoperability layer at company level, to leverage the AI acceleration

  

You will make the data fly inside Airbus Defence & Space and also from and to outside partners, customers or governments!

* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.

****Working Hours & Culture****

At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Director of Brand & Communications
description:
A
**profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote**
is looking for an experienced brand consultant, freelancer or agency to lead our brand revamp and set our brand direction as Head of Brand & Community, on a project / consultant basis! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has
**done it before**
and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has
**7+ years**
in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.
  
  
**The mission of this role**
Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.
  
  
**Who are we?**
We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
  
  

* Better Everyday: review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better
* Speed Is King: jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule
* Work Smart: use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data
* Overdeliver: bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)**
*90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.*

* More people know and search for our brands: branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
* More new customers come from word of mouth and press: share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
* We earn press and attention: earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
* Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact: shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
* The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere: quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social

**Key Objectives**

* Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct
* Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact
* Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press
* Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal
* Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage
* Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content
* Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget

**Requirements**

* Fully remote, project / consultant basis (freelancers, consultants and agencies welcome), based in Mexico, Ukraine or Brazil
* Fluent in English
* Brand Experience: 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands is ideal; 5-6 years with strong results is also considered
* Brand Builder: You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage
* Brand Moments: You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners
* Cause Marketing: You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page
* PR & Storytelling: You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it
* North America: You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors
* Brand Taste: A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint
* Commercial Mindset: You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
* Bonus points: pet industry experience

**Accountabilities**
*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* Brand foundation and guidelines: Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint
* Cause and shelter partnerships: Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact
* Brand moments and activations: Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams
* PR and earned media: Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention
* Community and customer stories: Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly
* Brand reporting and budget: Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

* Application + Screening Interview
* In-Depth Interview with the CEO
* Reference Calls
* Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO

**Rate Expectation**
**US$3,750-5,850 per month retainer (or equivalent day rate), based on experience and expertise.**

**Overview** WildBrain CPLG is a world-leading entertainment, sport and brand licensing agency with 20 offices worldwide. Since 1972 we have been providing our partners with dedicated licensing and marketing professionals and fully integrated retail, creative & product development, legal and accounting services.

We are looking to add to our talented team of innovators that can help us manage some of the most profitable and enduring brands in the world! We believe that our partnerships are about clarity, openness, and trust, and we are widely known for our straightforward approach.

**About the Role**

WildBrain CPLG is looking for a commercially driven Licensing Manager to join its MENA team in Dubai, reporting to the Commercial Director, MENA.

The Licensing Manager will take primary responsibility for managing and developing WildBrain CPLG's licensing business in Israel. This will include growing existing licensee relationships, identifying and securing new partners, and building relationships with key retail and commercial contacts.

The role will also support the wider MENA commercial team by developing business cases and pitches, maintaining sales materials, conducting retail visits and providing relevant market intelligence. In addition, the Licensing Manager will support the development of selected location-based entertainment opportunities across the region.

This is a hands-on commercial role for someone who can independently manage existing partnerships, develop new business in Israel and provide practical support to the wider regional growth plan.

 **Job Description**  

* Israel business development and account management
* Act as the main commercial contact for licensees and partners in Israel.
* Develop and implement the licensing strategy for Israel, aligned with regional priorities and licensor objectives.
* Manage and grow existing licensee relationships while identifying and securing new partners.
* Conduct market, retail and category analysis to identify gaps and new business opportunities.
* Develop commercial proposals and lead negotiations for new deals, renewals and amendments.
* Build and maintain relationships with key local retailers to improve retail placement and identify opportunities for licensed products.
* Help expand WildBrain CPLG’s portfolio by identifying opportunities to represent additional brands in Israel.
* Manage account performance and coordinate with Finance on reporting and payments.
* Own the Israel territory forecast, regularly reviewing revenue expectations, account performance and the commercial pipeline.
* Work with Creative Services and Product Development on product submissions and approvals, and with Legal on contract execution.

* Provide regular updates on the Israeli licensing and retail landscape.
* Travel to Israel for business when required.

MENA sales support

LBE development support

* Support the Global LBE team with local outreach, meetings and follow-up.
* Track regional LBE opportunities and relevant market developments**.**

  
**Qualifications**  

* Previous experience in sales, business development, or account management.
* Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Proven ability to manage existing accounts and develop new business opportunities.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
* Previous exposure to the Israeli market and understanding of the local retail landscape is preferred.
* Hebrew language skills are preferred but not essential.
* Previous experience in licensing, retail or consumer products is preferred.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactive, organised and able to work independently.
* Comfortable working with commercial data, forecasts and business plans.

* Willing and able to travel to Israel and elsewhere in the region when required.

  
**Additional Information**

We demonstrate our commitment to this by striving to provide a supportive work environment and a corporate culture that welcomes and encourages equal opportunities for all employees. We recognize that people bring experience and talent that goes beyond the technical skills and requirements of a job. If you possess similar experience that is close to what we’ve listed here, we encourage you to please still consider applying. We strongly believe that diverse experience, transferable skills, and passion are key! WildBrain accommodates people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Applicants are encouraged to make their needs known in advance if accommodation is required.

**About WildBrain CPLG**

WildBrain CPLG is a trusted licensing partner for leading brands worldwide, offering 50 years of expertise building consumer products and location-based entertainment programmes across the entertainment, sport, corporate and lifestyle sectors. With over 20 offices serving the UK, Europe, India, the Middle East, China, Asia Pacific and the US, WildBrain CPLG combines the strength of global reach with expertise in local markets to achieve the best results for partners. WildBrain CPLG is part of WildBrain Ltd., a global leader in kids’ and family entertainment. Please contact us or visit the WildBrain CPLG website for more information: www.cplg.com.

WildBrain CPLG, our global licensing and consumer products arm, represents our own and partner brands across major territories worldwide. Headquartered in Toronto, WildBrain trades on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: WILD). Visit us at wildbrain.com.

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Head of Growth

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Base Salary:** $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

**About Summit:**

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit's core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit's team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit's clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

**Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)**

* HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

* HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

* HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

**Colorectal Cancer (CRC)**

Government and public health agencies use our automated text, voice and email outreach, two-way texting and digital workflows (surveys, e-signature, scheduling) to reach the families they serve. Our largest footprint is WIC (Women, Infants & Children) nutrition programs, where Teletask messaging drives appointment attendance for over 6 million participants across 38 US states, with more than 100 million messages sent each year.

Teletask is part of Solen Software Group, which acquires and holds vertical market software businesses for the long term. The business is now at an inflection point and looking for a General Manager who will lead its next chapter of growth and build the commercial engine, team, and operating infrastructure to match the product.

**The Opportunity**

This is a general-manager role for someone who knows the industry from the inside. You will own the business's P&L, its growth, its product direction, its most important customer relationships, and its team, reporting to a Solen Portfolio Leader or Operating Partner and working within Solen's business systems and targets.

**What You Will Own**

**Business Performance**

* Own the full P&L: revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, net revenue retention and cash.
* Run a monthly operating cadence (KPIs, forecast vs. plan, actions) and report it to your Solen Portfolio Leader.
* Move the business up a Business Health Score (BHS) tier and improve its Rule of 40 through deliberate trade-offs between growth and profitability.
* Deliver the business's EBITDA growth as its contribution to Solen's Yearly Operations Goal (YOG), our portfolio-wide EBITDA growth target.
* Lead budgeting and forecasting with ROI discipline on every initiative and hire.

**Organic & Inorganic Growth**

* Grow ARR at a double-digit rate every year through new logos, expansion, pricing and retention.
* Own the pipeline from first contact to signed agreement across agency directors, state IT and operations leaders, and procurement officers.
* Build the sales playbook: ICP, outreach, discovery, proposal framework and RFP responses, with a repeatable path from local agency to statewide contract.
* Own pricing: re-evaluate customer usage, then set packaging, contract terms and price increases on the existing customer base.
* Cut churn by finding at-risk accounts early and running retention plays.
* Map the acquirable companies in the industry; source and qualify add-on targets and support integration.

**Industry Vision & Product Roadmap**

* Own a 1–3 year thesis on where the industry is heading: regulation, workflows, buyers and technology.
* Turn the thesis and customer needs into a roadmap ranked by ROI and by development effort vs. time-to-market.
